title: Sr. IT Systems Engineer
description: About Carrot: Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide. Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com . The Opportunity 🚀 Carrot is looking for a Sr. IT Systems Engineer to design, scale, and secure the identity, endpoint, and SaaS platforms that power our global, remote-first workforce. You will set the technical direction for how employees and devices connect to Carrot systems, while staying hands-on in the tooling, automation, and complex problem-solving that make IT reliable at scale. This role sits at the center of IT engineering. You will lead larger initiatives from design through rollout, partner closely with Information Security on zero-trust and compliance priorities, and raise the bar for the rest of the team through standards, documentation, and mentorship. If you want broad technical ownership, influence over the IT roadmap, and the chance to build systems that grow with a high-growth healthcare company, this role was built for that. What You’ll Own 💼 In this role, you will: Architect and own Carrot's identity, endpoint, and SaaS platforms, including Okta, JAMF, Intune, and Google Workspace, with a focus on security, reliability, and user experience Lead design and rollout of larger IT initiatives, such as zero-trust access models, device compliance frameworks, and global endpoint standards Build and maintain automation and infrastructure as code that manage configuration, provisioning, and lifecycle workflows at scale Partner with Information Security to design controls, drive vulnerability management, and keep Carrot audit-ready for SOC 2, HIPAA, and customer security reviews Serve as the senior technical escalation point, leading incident response and root cause analysis for complex or high-impact issues Define engineering standards, runbooks, and documentation, and mentor IT teammates to grow their technical depth Evaluate vendors and tools, build business cases, and make clear recommendations on build versus buy tradeoffs Design environments that support global care and operations teams, including secure and efficient remote computing setups Contribute to the IT roadmap and communicate priorities, risks, and progress to technical and business stakeholders What Success Looks Like 📈 In your first 12–18 months, you will have: Established a clear, documented architecture and standards for identity, endpoint, and SaaS management that the team can build on Delivered at least one major platform initiative, such as a zero-trust access model or endpoint modernization, with measurable gains in security posture and employee experience Reduced manual IT work through automation and infrastructure as code, with a measurable drop in recurring ticket volume Strengthened audit readiness, contributing to clean results on security and compliance reviews Raised the technical capability of the team through mentorship, documentation, and shared standards Built trusted partnerships with Information Security, People, Engineering, and Finance About You ✨ You likely have: 6+ years of experience in IT systems engineering, endpoint engineering, or infrastructure roles, including ownership of production platforms Deep, hands-on expertise with identity and access platforms such as Okta, including SSO, SCIM, lifecycle automation, and conditional access Expert-level experience managing Mac and Windows fleets with JAMF and Intune, including packaging, deployment, security policy, and compliance enforcement Strong scripting and automation skills (for example Python, Bash, or PowerShell), with experience using APIs and source-controlled configuration Experience designing and implementing security controls, such as encryption, vulnerability management, and zero-trust principles, in partnership with Security teams A track record of leading cross-functional technical projects from design through rollout without direct authority Experience mentoring or technically guiding other engineers Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex tradeoffs for executive and non-technical audiences Nice to Have ⭐ While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring: Experience in healthcare, health tech, or another regulated environment (for example, HIPAA or SOC 2) Experience with infrastructure as code and CI/CD practices applied to endpoint or SaaS configuration Hands-on experience with AWS or GCP and modern cloud networking concepts Experience designing remote computing environments for call center or clinical operations teams, such as VDI or managed browser models Experience building AI-assisted workflows or tooling to improve IT operations Relevant certifications (for example JAMF Certified Expert, Okta Certified Professional, or Microsoft Endpoint Administrator) Why This Role Matters 🧡 Every Carrot employee depends on technology that is secure, reliable, and easy to use, whether they are supporting members through deeply personal care journeys or partnering with global employers. This role sets the technical foundation that makes that possible. As Carrot continues to scale across geographies and functions, the architecture and standards you establish will protect member trust, strengthen our security posture, and give the business the speed and confidence to keep growing. Why Candidates Join Carrot 🌍 Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission. Highlights include: A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally. A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact. Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits. Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge. Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits. A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture. The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide. Compensation 💰 Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their lives inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. Base Salary Range: $150,000 – $175,000 (primary range). Geo-Tier Adjustment: Up to $190,000 for highly experienced candidates within 50 miles of San Francisco, NYC, or Seattle. Actual compensation may vary from the posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience. Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com A Note on AI At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves. Why Carrot? Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com.

title: Sales & Marketing Operations Specialist - Mexico
description: Brafton is one of the world's leading content marketing firms, with offices in Boston, London, Toronto and Sydney. We aspire to continually raise the bar on what people consider "marketing content." We create result-focused strategies and content to drive SEO, social engagement and leads for our clients. Our teams continuously build expertise across new media formats, including video, blogs, infographics and web design. This is a 100% remote, full-time contract position open to applicants in Mexico. Please include a resume in English. POSITION SUMMARY We're looking for a Sales & Marketing Operations Specialist to join our growing Sales Operations consulting team, supporting both internal initiatives and client-facing projects focused on improving sales, marketing, and revenue operations. In this role, you'll work alongside Sales & Marketing Operations Consultants to help organizations optimize their CRM platforms, automate business processes, improve lead management, implement end-to-end tracking and attribution, and deliver meaningful reporting that drives better business decisions. You'll support a variety of projects ranging from CRM optimization and data management to marketing technology implementations, analytics, AI-enabled workflows, and operational consulting. This position is ideal for someone with experience in CRM, marketing technology, analytics, and sales operations who enjoys solving business problems, learning new technologies, and working across multiple industries and client environments. CORE RESPONSIBILITIES Support the delivery of Sales & Marketing Operations consulting projects for internal teams and external clients. Configure, optimize, and maintain CRM platforms and related business systems (including HubSpot, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, and similar technologies). Design and improve lead management processes, including lifecycle stages, lead routing, lead scoring, qualification frameworks, and sales handoff. Build and maintain reporting dashboards and executive-level analytics that provide actionable business insights. Implement and troubleshoot lead tracking, attribution, and conversion measurement across CRM, analytics, and advertising platforms. Configure and validate marketing and analytics platforms including Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and similar technologies. Support campaign tracking through UTM strategies, conversion tracking, offline conversion imports, and CRM-to-ad platform integrations. Review CRM data quality and recommend improvements to data structure, automation, reporting, and operational processes. Assist with CRM implementations, migrations, system integrations, API connections, and data imports. Support marketing automation, email campaigns, nurture programs, and campaign operations. Research, enrich, and maintain company and contact data to improve CRM accuracy. Leverage AI tools and emerging technologies to improve operational efficiency, automate repetitive tasks, generate insights, and enhance client reporting. Participate in client discovery sessions, solution design, implementation, testing, documentation, and user acceptance. Develop process documentation, training materials, and implementation guides for both internal teams and clients. Collaborate with sales, marketing, client services, and technical teams to deliver operational improvements. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS Minimum 2 years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, CRM Administration, Marketing Operations, Digital Marketing, Analytics, or a related field. Experience working with CRM platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar systems. Experience with lead tracking, attribution, conversion measurement, and marketing analytics across CRM and digital marketing platforms. Familiarity with analytics and advertising platforms such as Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, or similar technologies. Understanding of CRM configuration, workflows, automation, reporting, and data management. Experience supporting marketing automation, lead management, or campaign operations. Familiarity with AI tools (such as ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, Gemini, or similar) and an interest in applying AI to improve business processes and operational efficiency. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced, client-focused environment. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience working directly with clients in a consulting or agency environment. Experience implementing or troubleshooting marketing attribution, conversion tracking, offline conversion imports, or CRM integrations with advertising platforms. Familiarity with CRM migrations, APIs, middleware, or automation platforms such as Zapier, Make, or Workato. Experience with reporting and BI tools such as Looker Studio, Power BI, Tableau, or CRM reporting. Familiarity with sales intelligence and enrichment platforms such as Apollo, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar tools. Experience designing dashboards, KPI frameworks, or executive reporting. Demonstrated ability to identify opportunities for AI-driven automation and process improvement. Compensation Additional Information

title: Senior Product Manager - Audiobooks Format Foundations
description: We design Spotify’s consumer experience - end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify. We’re seeking a Senior Product Manager to help lead the audiobook experience across Spotify’s mobile apps. You’ll join Format Foundations within Core Experience and partner closely with the Audiobooks business unit to shape how listeners discover, evaluate, enjoy, and build lasting relationships with audiobooks on Spotify. What You'll Do Lead product strategy for Spotify’s audiobook experience, shaping how the format becomes more engaging, valuable, and enjoyable for listeners, creators, and the business. Define and evolve the experience across the audiobook journey, from discovery and evaluation through playback, library management, and reading. Partner closely with the Audiobooks business unit to translate business strategy and listener needs into product innovation that supports growth. Drive innovation across multimodal experiences, including the intersection of listening and reading. Partner with Engineering, Design, Data, and other cross-functional teams to deliver intuitive, high-quality experiences at scale. Use data, experimentation, and user insights to make informed product decisions and continuously improve the experience. Build alignment across Core Experience, Audiobooks, Personalization, and other partners to create a cohesive Spotify experience. Lead complex cross-functional initiatives end to end, setting direction and scope, creating alignment, and partnering with Engineering on delivery. Who You Are You have 5+ years of product management experience, including meaningful experience with audiobook, ebook, digital reading, or related consumer products. You have a deep understanding of the audiobook or digital reading landscape, including user behavior, publisher ecosystems, and competitive dynamics. You have experience building consumer products for mobile platforms such as iOS and Android, including complex user experiences. You understand how to build scalable systems and experiences that help teams move faster. You know how to balance user needs, technical considerations, and business impact when making product decisions. You care deeply about creating intuitive, high-quality consumer experiences at scale. You have partnered closely with Engineering, Design, Data, and other disciplines to bring products from strategy through delivery. You can influence stakeholders across functions and levels to build alignment and drive meaningful outcomes. title: Clinical Operations Lead
description: Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases. GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development. We operate as a private, profit-with-purpose company, channeling our commercial success back into scientific research, technology, and our people. With approximately 700 people across multiple countries and three service lines, we are growing deliberately, and the capability of our leaders and our organization is central to how we get there. If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you! Job Overview As a Clinical Operations Lead , you will provide clinical operations oversight for projects at a regional or global level, ensuring study deliverables, CRA activities and investigator sites are managed in accordance with the protocol, monitoring plan, ICH-GCP guidelines and applicable local regulations. You will act as a key liaison between CRAs and the clinical project team, providing operational guidance, training and oversight throughout the study. The role will also support site start-up and feasibility, recruitment and enrolment strategies, monitoring performance, issue escalation and corrective actions, while contributing to study planning, documentation and overall project delivery. Key Responsabilities Provide oversight of regional CRAs and investigator sites, ensuring compliance with study protocols, monitoring plans, ICH-GCP, local regulations and study timelines. Conduct co-monitoring and CRA assessment visits as required, supporting site and CRA performance and ensuring monitoring standards are maintained. Proactively monitor site and country performance, including recruitment, data collection, document collection and TMF activities, and communicate progress to the clinical project team. Oversee regional site start-up and feasibility activities and support vendor management activities where required. Review monitoring visit reports for quality, compliance and appropriate site management, ensuring project deliverables are completed accurately and on time. Serve as a key point of contact for regional CRAs, providing study-specific guidance, resolving issues and escalating matters to the Project Manager or relevant functions when appropriate. Provide training and mentoring to CRAs on study procedures, clinical plans, guidelines and timelines, and ensure study-specific training is completed and documented. Participate in Sponsor meetings and CRA calls, providing updates on country and site performance and operational progress. Develop and implement enrolment and recruitment strategies and create study tools, training materials, monitoring plans and other clinical operations documentation. Support the clinical project team with study deliverables, presentations, site management activities, protocol deviations, financial project activities and other operational objectives as required. Skills & Qualifications 4–6 years of relevant clinical research experience required, with 7–9 years preferred. Minimum 3 years of CRA experience, with strong hands-on understanding of clinical monitoring activities. Post-secondary certificate/diploma required; a Bachelor’s degree in Health Sciences, Life Sciences, Nursing or a related discipline is preferred. Strong understanding of ICH-GCP, local regulations, IRB/EC requirements and Investigator responsibilities as they relate to clinical monitoring. Experience working with EDC systems and clinical research documentation. Strong understanding of clinical trial processes, site management, monitoring activities and study performance metrics. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate with CRAs, Sponsors, investigators and cross-functional teams. Strong organisational, interpersonal and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a dynamic environment. Highly proactive, detail-oriented, task-driven and organised, with strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities. Proficiency in Microsoft Office and demonstrated ability to prepare high-quality reports, presentations and clinical research documentation. SoCRA and/or ACRP certification/designation is an advantage. What We Offer In addition, as an Alimentiv Employee, you’re also eligible for the following programs: Education Reimbursement program for full-time employees Monthly Cell Phone and Remote Work Allowance (dependent on role eligibility) One time office setup allowance (can be used to purchase a scanner/printer, extra monitor, office furniture, etc.) Working while visiting program – up to 4 weeks per year! Flexible Summer Hours Program from May – September Employee referral incentive – we know great people know other great people, and we think that warrants recognition! Full-time employees also become beneficiaries of the Alimentiv Trust after one year of employment, and permanent members after 5 years of employment Optional formal mentorship program (Alimentorship); country/region annual social events in person; leadership development programs for people leaders in accordance with your seniority; social committee and several other optional initiatives designed to support you in feeling like part of the Alimentiv team! Additional benefits may be available depending on the country of employment and are subject to local policies and eligibility. Our Services End-to-end GI clinical trial services, from protocol design through submission support Central medical imaging management and endoscopic reading Precision medicine and biomarker solutions Real-world evidence and clinical consulting Histopathology and lab services through AcelaBio How to Apply To apply for this position, please submit your resume through the Alimentiv Careers Portal or via LinkedIn’s Easy Apply. Resumes must be submitted in English. Equal Opportunity and Accessibility Alimentiv is committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, ethnicity, national origin, religion or belief, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital or family status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Accommodations are available upon request for persons with disabilities throughout the recruitment and selection process. Requests can be directed to recruitment@alimentiv.com . Compensation Additional Information Stay Alert to Recruitment Scams Alimentiv is aware of a continued increase in phishing scams, which use various methods of attack via email, text, voice and social media, including individuals posing as our recruiters and contacting candidates with fraudulent opportunities. Our hiring process always includes direct engagement with a recruiter or hiring manager, and we will never ask for sensitive personal information early in the process. Official communication will only come from company email addresses containing "@alimentiv.com". If you are contacted about an open job at Alimentiv, please verify the domain of the sender's email address and confirm that you are being asked to apply on this website. If something doesn't feel right, we encourage you to verify before responding. If you believe you have been the victim of a phishing scam, please contact your local government cyber authority to report it.

title: PMO & Portfolio Analyst

title: Senior Platform Engineer - US Remote
description: What is PerfectServe? PerfectServe is a leading provider of clinical communication and physician scheduling solutions in the health IT space. title: Senior Web Engineer - Subscriptions
description: The Subscriptions Mission is shaping the future of how millions of people discover, purchase, and experience Spotify Premium. We build the platforms and tools that power Spotify's global subscription business, enabling new offers, pricing strategies, and commerce experiences that help our business move quickly while delivering exceptional experiences for listeners. Join the Monaco squad, where we create the internal products that enable Spotify teams to launch, configure, and manage Premium offers with confidence. From subscriptions and prepaid products to pricing updates and promotional campaigns, our tools support business-critical operations through intuitive experiences, trusted workflows, and reliable platform services. As a Senior Web Engineer, you'll develop end-to-end solutions spanning modern web applications. Working closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and business partners, you'll help create the tools that enable Spotify's global subscription business to innovate safely, efficiently, and at scale. What You'll Do Build end-to-end features across modern web applications that support Spotify's global subscription business. Create intuitive internal products that enable business teams to launch, configure, and manage Premium offers through secure, guided workflows. Develop GraphQL and gRPC APIs that connect frontend applications with distributed platform services. Design efficient database schemas, implement data migrations, and optimize application performance using PostgreSQL. Build secure, reliable, and auditable systems that support business-critical financial operations and SOX-compliant approval workflows. Collaborate with engineers across the Subscriptions Mission to evolve shared platform capabilities, improve developer experience, and increase platform reliability. Write maintainable, well-tested code while contributing to technical design, architecture discussions, code reviews, and continuous improvement. Participate in an on-call rotation to help maintain the reliability and availability of services powering Spotify Premium. Who You Are You have experience building and delivering production software across on the front end. You have built modern web applications using TypeScript, React, and Next.js. title: Customer Success Architect, Japan

Reporting into the APJ Customer Success organization, you'll own a portfolio of GitLab's most strategic enterprise and Government accounts, act as the executive-level technical liaison for these accounts, and drive cross-functional resolution of their highest-priority issues — coordinating and, where needed, directing the efforts of Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Professional Services, and Support. Leads end-to-end resolution of critical, cross-functional account escalations, ensuring root causes are identified, follow-up actions are owned, holding internal teams accountable to timelines, driving the driving root cause analysis and personally managing executive communication and risk. title: Senior Director, Analytics and Data Science, Core Product & Growth
description: About Life360 Life360's mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 102.4 million monthly active users (MAU), as of June 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries. Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family). Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit life360.com . Life360 is a Remote First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US and Canada) regardless of any specified location above. We are AI Native We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process. Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy. About The Team The Data & Analytics Team (DnA) is a 60+ person organization spanning data engineering, analytics engineering, analytics/decision science, and data science/ML. The science teams are organized into two sub teams, focusing on MAU and Revenue. This role leads decision science and data science within MAU. You and your team will be responsible for understanding the drivers behind MAU: why members come, why they stay, and why they return. The team partners with product, marketing, and engineering to put those learnings into everyday work, and that work shapes our roadmaps. Our data is unusual for a consumer company. Life360 measures families and circles rather than individuals, so one member's behavior affects another's, which makes measurement a different problem than a standard funnel. With billions of location events, driving behavior, crash detection, and Tile and Pet GPS trackers, we get a rich picture of physical behavior that few consumer companies can build. About the Job This Senior Director leads MAU Analytics and Data Science. You and your team will work across acquisition, activation, engagement, and retention on the analysis, models, and experiments behind each. A lot of what this role owns needs to be built rather than maintained: the measurement, the standards, and how the team uses AI. The team is also raising its craft, and coaching people through that is an important part of the job. Within a year, your team members will be operating at an elevated skill level, proactively bringing key questions to light, and serving as trusted advisors whom stakeholders consult for strategic guidance rather than simple task execution. You will report to the Head of Data and work closely with counterparts leading Revenue Analytics and Data Science, and with the leaders of Data Engineering. For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $247,000 to $366,000 USD. For candidates based out of Canada, the salary range for this position is $286,000 to $339,000 CAD. We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers. Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) , as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits. What You'll Do Lead and develop the decision scientists and data scientists on the team, and set the quality bar for both disciplines. Own the MAU driver model and the forecast. Own the exploratory work that drives the strategy to grow MAU. Establish how an analysis gets scoped, run, reviewed, and written up, so its quality does not depend on who picked up the request. Partner with your Revenue counterpart and Data Engineering leadership to define common metrics, align on experimentation standards, and introduce unified operating practices across teams. Build the operating model that gets the team into the roadmap conversation early, with a view on what to build and what to test. Use agents and automated analysis daily, and expect the same of the team. Shape how the team works AI-native: what gets delegated to agents, what gets automated, and what stays human judgment. What We're Looking For Required Experience & Qualifications 10+ years in analytics, data science, or decision science, including 5+ years in people management in a senior leadership role. Deep expertise in inferential and causal analytics. Able to lead ML practitioners. Expert knowledge of engagement, retention, churn, and cohort metrics. Experience forecasting a company-level metric and being held to it. SQL, plus Python or R. Experience with Databricks, third party experimentation tools (e.g. Statsig), Tableau or similar BI tools, and AI native BI tools (e.g. Hex, AI/BI). Hands-on with coding agents (Claude Code or equivalent) in your own analytical work. Bachelor's degree or equivalent. Nice to Have Familiarity with experiment design to identify and control for network effects. Master’s degree or PhD with an emphasis in social science, psychology or other behavioral science. Experience leading a team that reports to you but sits embedded with product and engineering teams. Experience in a B2C subscription business. Core Expectations You have moved an analytics team from reactive to embedded. You coach and develop people, and you have grown analysts into leaders. On your teams, analysis starts from a hypothesis rather than a data request. You have built the standards a team works from, and got people to use them. You are curious about why people behave the way they do, not just what they did. You decide what the team does not work on, and you can defend it. Our Benefits Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for US employees). We offer life and disability as well as supplemental plans for medical and dental for Canadian employees. 401(k) plan with company matching program in the US and RRSP with DPSP plan for Canadian employees. Paid parental leave Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns Learning & Development programs Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment. Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers. Life360 Values Our company's mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust. Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it's hard. Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families. High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done. Our Commitment to Diversity We believe that different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds create a stronger and more creative work environment that delivers better results. Together, we continue to build an inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. It fuels our innovation and connects us closer to our customers and the communities we serve. We strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and where everyone feels empowered to bring their authentic best selves to work. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Life360. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any legally protected status. We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that a diversity of perspectives and experiences create a foundation for the best ideas. Come join us in building something meaningful. Even if you don't meet 100% of the below qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying! #LI-Remote

title: Staff Software Engineer, Platform Infrastructure
description: Astronomer empowers data teams to bring mission-critical software, analytics, and AI to life and is the company behind Astro, the industry-leading unified DataOps platform powered by Apache Airflow®. Astro accelerates building reliable data products that unlock insights, unleash AI value, and powers data-driven applications. Trusted by more than 800 of the world's leading enterprises, Astronomer lets businesses do more with their data. To learn more, visit www.astronomer.io . About this role Astronomer’s products run on a complex, multi-cloud platform — and the scalability, and operational maturity of that platform is what we’re actively investing in. The work ahead on our Platform team isn’t about managing data or curating pipelines; it’s about building the foundational systems that everything else runs on — the kind of systems where the failure modes matter, the latency budgets are real, and getting it wrong has visible consequences for hundreds of enterprise customers. We’re looking for a Staff+-level engineer who has built production platform systems at scale before — not just consumed them. You’ve designed systems under load, reasoned carefully about failure, and made your colleagues’ lives better by giving them something solid and well-understood to build on top of. You write strategy documents and then write the code that proves them out. You’ve been the person who made the call, and lived with the consequences. This is a foundational role at a consequential moment: your work will directly shape what Astronomer’s products — Astro, Observe, and our IDE — are capable of over the next several years. What you get to do Astronomer has a healthy and complex infrastructure estate spanning multiple cloud providers, a mix of managed and self-hosted systems, and an increasingly ambitious set of requirements as our products evolve. We have a clear sense of where we need to go; we need the right person to figure out how to get there and then go build it. This is very much a technical role — you’ll be just as involved in building these systems as in specifying and designing them. We’re not looking for someone to write strategy documents; we’re looking for someone who writes the strategy and the code, and who has done exactly that before at scale. Blaze a Trail : Own and develop our platform infrastructure strategy, with the sponsorship and responsibility to match. Map out what we need, make the calls, and own the outcomes. Be an Owner : Be directly involved in deciding what we work on and how we work on it. Make promises, and keep them. Do Sensible Things : Make principled build vs. buy assessments and advocate for the right tools for the right job — not the fashionable ones, not the ones already in the estate just because they’re there. Garage Door Open : Create and maintain comprehensive internal documentation and decision records for systems and processes. Participate in architectural forums and make principled, open decisions that the rest of the organisation can learn from and hold us to. What you bring to the role Distributed systems depth, grounded in practice. You have a solid working model of how production systems fail — consistency and availability tradeoffs, failure cascades, backpressure, graceful degradation. You can draw the diagram, explain the failure modes at each node, and make a reasoned argument for which ones actually matter in a given context. NALSD thinking is how you naturally approach a new system design. Kubernetes at operator depth. You know what happens inside the scheduler and the control loop when things go wrong, because you’ve been there. You’ve operated clusters under real load, not just deployed workloads onto them. Strong Go proficiency. The platform team writes production Go. You should be fluent: you’ve built and shipped systems in it, and you have opinions about what good Go looks like. Multi-cloud experience, not just multi-cloud exposure. You’ve made considered architectural decisions across AWS, GCP, and/or Azure — not just consumed managed services, but evaluated tradeoffs between them and lived with those decisions in production. Experience defining requirements and driving technology choices across an engineering organization. You’ve been the person in the room who frames the decision correctly, not just the one who executes it. Strong written and verbal communication. You can write a design doc that changes minds, and a postmortem that makes the organisation smarter. You’ve worked effectively in a globally-distributed team.
