You'll own the vision, roadmap, and requirements for internal go-to-market applications, starting with Command Center, which helps field teams act on product usage and consumption data. You'll decide what those applications need to do and how they should fit with the rest of the stack. Engineering will own their technical architecture, code, and infrastructure. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, reporting to the Director, Revenue Technology, within Revenue Operations.</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Define how internal and third-party tools fit together, including integrations, data flows, and governance, in partnership with the people who manage each tool.</li> <li value="2">Recommend when to build, buy, or consolidate tools based on cost, return on investment, and how well each option meets the needs of go-to-market teams.</li> <li value="3">Own the roadmap for Command Center and other internal applications. Turn requests from Sales, Solutions Architecture, Customer Experience, Product, and Ecosystem into clear requirements, and explain what you won't prioritize and why.</li> <li value="4">Partner with Engineering to deliver applications that fit the existing stack and limit technical debt. Lead user acceptance testing, launch, documentation, and enablement, then use adoption data to decide what to improve, expand, or retire.</li> <li value="5">Set the long-term direction of the revenue technology stack with Revenue Strategy, Revenue Operations, and field leaders as the business and artificial intelligence capabilities evolve.</li> <li value="6">Build artificial intelligence and automation workflows that save time for Revenue Technology and go-to-market teams, and help the team decide when to use them.</li> <li value="7">Bring consumption metrics into the tools and workflows field teams rely on, and adapt them as GitLab's consumption model matures.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Experience in Revenue Operations, Sales or Customer Success Operations, business systems, or a related role, with ownership of tools from defining the use case and choosing a solution through launch.</li> <li value="2">Experience designing or guiding a go-to-market technology stack, including how tools connect and share data through application programming interfaces, integrations, data models, and permissions. Working knowledge of Salesforce, product usage data, and revenue tools such as Gainsight, Clari, Gong, or Outreach.</li> <li value="3">Hands-on experience with a consumption- or usage-based business model, including how teams use consumption metrics across the customer lifecycle.</li> <li value="4">Experience delivering internal tools with engineering teams, including writing scoped requirements and acceptance criteria and running user acceptance testing before release.</li> <li value="5">Experience making build-versus-buy or consolidation decisions based on cost, return on investment, and business fit. You can reconcile competing requests from senior stakeholders and explain your decisions clearly.</li> <li value="6">Experience shipping artificial intelligence agents or workflows people rely on, with the judgment to know where automation helps and where it adds complexity.</li> <li value="7">Strong written communication in an all-remote, asynchronous environment. You can prioritize your work, keep teammates informed, and collaborate through issues, documents, and merge requests.</li> </ul> <p>Experience querying data directly with Structured Query Language (SQL) or a comparable tool, working with go-to-market analytics, or supporting field enablement is helpful, not required. We welcome transferable skills from related roles.</p> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>Revenue Technology owns the tools GitLab's go-to-market teams use, whether we build them or buy them. title: Das Gesicht unserer Brand auf TikTok
description: Manche Dinge muss man nicht erklären. TRIONE ist eine Luxury Lifestyle Brand für Accessoires und Schmuck, designed in Marbella. Japanische Seidenkordel, graviertes Gold, Details, die man erst auf den zweiten Blick entdeckt und dann nicht mehr vergisst. Unser ONE Armband ist kein Accessoire, es ist ein Statement für Menschen, die nicht laut sein müssen, um gesehen zu werden. Jetzt bringen wir TRIONE auf TikTok. Nicht mit Countdowns und Rabattcodes, sondern mit Ästhetik, Haltung und Geschichten. Mit Videos und ausgewählten Livestreams aus unserem eigenen Store, von unseren Events und von Orten, die so besonders sind wie unsere Pieces. Dafür suchen wir die Person, die unsere Welt vor der Kamera spürbar macht. Deine Rolle Du bist das Gesicht von TRIONE auf TikTok, in Videos und in Livestreams aus unserem Store, von exklusiven Events und luxuriösen Locations Du erzählst die Geschichten hinter unseren Pieces, nicht ihre Preise Du gestaltest mit uns Content, der sich anfühlt wie die Brand selbst: ruhig, ästhetisch, selbstbewusst Du bist dabei, wenn eine Brand ihre nächste Ebene erreicht Was dich ausmacht Natürliche Präsenz vor der Kamera Ein Auge für Ästhetik, Fashion und Details Du verstehst TikTok und weißt, was Menschen wirklich innehalten lässt Stil, Verlässlichkeit und sehr gutes Deutsch Was dich erwartet Sichtbarkeit als Gesicht einer Brand, die man nicht übersieht Einladungen zu unseren exklusiven Events und Zugang zu unserem Netzwerk aus Creatorn und Partnern Pieces aus unserer Kollektion Ein kleines Team, kurze Wege und echter Einfluss auf das, was entsteht Flexible Zeiten neben Uni oder Job Für wen Diese Stelle ist als Pflichtpraktikum ausgeschrieben und richtet sich an Studierende, die laut Studien- oder Prüfungsordnung ihrer Hochschule ein Pflichtpraktikum absolvieren müssen. Da es sich um ein gesetzlich geregeltes Pflichtpraktikum handelt, ist keine Vergütung vorgesehen. Dafür bekommst du Pieces aus unserer Kollektion, Zugang zu unseren Events und eine Praktikumsbescheinigung für deine Hochschule. Start ist ab sofort. Wenn du beim Lesen schon weißt, dass du das bist, schreib uns. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As a Journey Architect on GitLab's Digital Customer Outcomes team, you'll design journeys that turn meaningful customer actions into retention, consumption and revenue outcomes. You'll own journey design and service blueprints for assigned customer cohorts, products or coverage models, leading cross-functional work from design through launch. Digital Orchestration builds and runs the journeys day to day; you'll remain accountable for their outcomes and ongoing improvement. You'll add design capacity to help priority journeys, including artificial intelligence (AI) and consumption journeys, launch in fiscal year 2028 (FY28).</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Design journeys backward from business outcomes to meaningful customer actions, audiences and engagement tactics. Map each cohort's intended path, timing, signals that customers need help and interventions to get them back on track.</li> <li value="2">Decide which steps are self-serve, AI-assisted or human-led, and define the handoffs between them. Design across in-product guidance, email, events and community, choosing the right channel for each moment.</li> <li value="3">Build service blueprints with Customer Experience (CX) Operations, documenting the people, systems, data, content and handoffs behind each touchpoint. Give every step a trigger, a response, an owner and a metric.</li> <li value="4">Write journey specifications covering steps, triggers, audiences, channels, content, handoffs and metrics. Set build plans, coordinate partner teams and clear dependencies to launch on time and to specification.</li> <li value="5">Specify the content and self-service resources each step needs, and work with content teams to create and govern them. Partner with Lifecycle Marketing on audience, sequencing and delivery so customers experience one coordinated journey.</li> <li value="6">Hand live journeys to Digital Orchestration to run, remain accountable for their outcomes and build in regular optimization cycles with the Digital Outcomes team's Data/Insights partner.</li> <li value="7">Measure journey coverage, step conversion, lift against comparison groups, meaningful actions, recovery after interventions, time to value and influence on retention. Track partner adoption of the shared journeys and blueprints.</li> <li value="8">Apply the framework and standards set by the Lead Journey Architect, and help improve them based on what your journeys teach the team.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Experience in customer journey design, service design or digital customer success.</li> <li value="2">A track record of turning journey designs into launched programs with measurable outcomes.</li> <li value="3">Hands-on experience building service blueprints and designing handoffs between digital and human teams.</li> <li value="4">Working knowledge of journey orchestration, in-app guidance and marketing automation platforms.</li> <li value="5">Comfort defining customer signals and success metrics, and interpreting funnel conversion and test results.</li> <li value="6">Experience leading cross-functional work through launch without direct authority.</li> <li value="7">Experience in business-to-business software as a service is helpful, as is domain knowledge of development and operations (DevOps) or development, security and operations (DevSecOps).</li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The Digital Customer Outcomes team brings digital experiences and human support together around customer outcomes. You'll work day to day with the Lead Journey Architect, Digital Orchestration and the Digital Outcomes team's Data/Insights partner, alongside CX Operations, Lifecycle Marketing, Marketing Engineering and Operations, Content, Product, CX Engineering, Customer Success, Renewals and CX Services. You'll bring these partners together around shared journeys and blueprints so customer touchpoints line up rather than compete.</p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. title: Dealer Development Manager (Dallas / Fort Worth)
description: Upgrade helps customers move in the right direction with affordable and responsible financial products. Since 2017, we’ve helped over 7.5 million customers access over $42 billion in consumer credit. With a relentless focus on improving our customers' financial well-being, we build products that put more money in their pocket and support their journey toward a better financial future. We’re backed by some of the most prominent technology investors and were most recently valued at $7.3B. We’re consistently recognized for our collaborative and inclusive culture. Most recently, we were named one of the World’s Top Fintech Companies by CNBC, Best Places to Work by Built In, Best Places to Work by the San Francisco Business Times, America’s Greatest Workplaces by Newsweek, Best Startup Employer by Forbes, and Healthiest Employers by Phoenix Business Journal. We’re looking for new team members who get excited about designing and delivering new and better products. Come join us and help build a better financial future for millions of people. About the Role: The Dealer Development Manager will represent Upgrade Inc (Auto Finance Division) and promote our indirect lending programs. They will develop, maintain, and grow business partnerships between Upgrade Inc. and our dealership partners. The Dealer Development Manager is also responsible for staying up-to-date on local market conditions and industry trends. In this role, you will work with internal partners to find solutions that better serve our customers, and build long lasting relationships with key decision makers to drive growth and continuous improvement. This position requires residency in Dallas/Fort Worth, TX. What You’ll Do: Dealer Relationship Management Develop and maintain relationships with new and existing dealer partners Act as a trusted advisor to dealership owners, GMs, and F&I managers Conduct regular in-person dealership visits based on a structured drive schedule Deliver consistent follow-up and service to ensure dealer satisfaction and loyalty Dealer Acquisition & Activation Identify, onboard, and activate new dealer partners Drive dealer sign-ups and first deals (“activation”) Re-engage inactive dealers (e.g., no deals in 90 days) and return them to production Execute onboarding training to ensure dealers understand programs and systems Production & Volume Growth Achieve monthly funding and application volume goals Increase contracts per active dealer and overall territory production Focus on growing volume in Tier 3–5 segments while maintaining quality Drive penetration targets (e.g., 3+ and 5+ deals per dealer per month) Credit & Deal Structuring Partner closely with underwriting/credit teams to structure deals effectively Educate dealers on program guidelines, stips, and deal packaging Improve pull-through by coaching dealers on submitting clean, fundable deals Portfolio Performance & Quality Monitor dealer portfolio performance (delinquency, charge-offs, profitability) Manage dealer mix to align with company risk appetite and profitability goals Shift focus toward preferred collateral and higher-performing dealers Ensure adherence to compliance, credit policies, and documentation standards Training & Dealer Development Conduct ongoing product and process training with dealership staff Educate dealers on value-added products Provide market insights and best practices to improve dealer success Position the company as a relationship-driven partner vs. transactional lender Territory & Activity Management Maintain a disciplined weekly drive schedule maximizing in-person dealer time Track and manage activity through CRM (e.g., Salesforce) Analyze territory performance and adjust strategy based on data Participate in team calls, sales meetings, and performance reviews What We Look For: 2+ years of experience in indirect auto finance, auto sales, or related field Strong understanding of credit tiers, loan structuring, and dealership operations Proven ability to build relationships and drive sales growth Excellent communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills Self-motivated with strong time management and territory planning skills Ability to travel locally (significant field time required) What We Offer You: Competitive salary, uncapped commission and stock option plan Paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance Flexible PTO Competitive 401(k) Opportunities for professional growth and development Paid parental leave Health & wellness initiatives #LI-Hybrid For California residents: Upgrade's California Notice at Collection and Privacy Policy describes our practices regarding the collection, use, and disclosure of the personal information of job applicants. Environmental & Working Conditions Work is performed indoors in a fast-paced environment that requires the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet established workflows, schedules, and service expectations. Employees regularly input, retrieve, and exchange information accurately using digital systems and applications to support operational and customer service objectives. The role requires the ability to receive and exchange information with customers, peers, supervisors, and cross-functional partners through available communication channels, which may include meetings, email, phone, and digital collaboration tools, and may involve real-time, verbal, or in-person exchanges depending on business need. Job duties may involve managing a high volume of inbound and/or outbound customer interactions and work activities using telecommunications and computer systems. The role requires the ability to read, analyze, and interpret information displayed on computer screens and remain in a working posture for extended periods, consistent with the demands of the position. Work may be performed in a contact center, office, or remote environment, depending on business needs and the nature of the role. Onsite work environments may include shared workspaces, standard office lighting, and moderate background noise typical of customer service or operational settings. Employees working remotely are responsible for maintaining a secure and productive workspace with reliable internet connectivity that supports company systems and safeguards the confidentiality of company and customer information. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Upgrade does not accept unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies, search firms, or any third parties. Any resume submitted to any employee of Upgrade without a prior written agreement in place will be considered the property of Upgrade, and Upgrade will not be obligated to pay any referral or placement fee. Agencies must obtain advance written approval from Upgrade's Talent Acquisition department to submit resumes and only in conjunction with a valid, fully executed agreement.

title: B2B Paid Media Senior Manager
description: Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world. GET TO KNOW US At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company. We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing! THE OPPORTUNITY We are hiring a B2B Paid Media Senior Manager to our Marketing team in Brazil! This role joins the Revenue Marketing team and focuses on our largest market, Brazil. You will lead our digital marketing initiatives across paid channels and use AI to increase demand generation, lead generation, awareness, and engagement for Wellhub. You will report to the Global Paid Media Director and work closely with the marketing, paid media, and creative teams. You will also manage end-to-end execution of ABM/hyper-targeted, awareness, lead gen, and full-funnel campaigns on LinkedIn, Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta, and more. The role is hands-on: you will design campaigns, analyze performance, and optimize strategy. You will also build, motivate, and lead an in-house Paid Media team in Brazil. The work centers on high-priority strategic projects with visibility to senior leadership. YOUR IMPACT Own the Paid Media strategy for Brazil and its role in the overall marketing strategy, in partnership with regional marketing leadership. Drive the region's targets (cost per MQL, CPA, ROAS, lead and MQL quality, MQL-to-SQL conversion, and B2B pipeline and revenue), focusing on profitable results at scale and on lead quality over volume. Lead end-to-end campaign execution across Google and Microsoft Ads (Bing), paid social (Meta and LinkedIn), retargeting, display, and DV360 for SMB and Enterprise audiences. Build retargeting and lookalike audiences from our HubSpot database, and connect ad platform data to the CRM so we can measure quality through MQL, SQL, and pipeline. Run growth experiments, full-funnel B2B campaigns, attribution analysis, and A/B tests, including user-generated content ads and static ad testing on paid social. Embed AI in daily work, from campaign analysis and audience discovery to creative testing, reporting automation, and forecasting. Claude is our primary tool, and you will use our AI Library and internal Paid Media tools. Design the tests that show when platform AI features (Performance Max, AI Max, Meta Advantage+, LinkedIn predictive audiences) beat manual setups. Bring a strategic view that goes beyond what AI suggests: analyze results and propose hypotheses of your own. Establish how the team uses AI responsibly (data privacy, brand safety, quality checks, human sign-off). Build AI-enabled workflows, prompts, and agents, and share them with other regions through the team's AI Library. Lead, motivate, and develop the in-house team in Brazil. Coach them to build AI fluency and measure the gains in speed, efficiency, and performance. Partner with marketing, creative, data analytics, and sales (including SDRs), and build trust with senior stakeholders. Report results, keep everyone aligned with the Regional Marketing team, and represent Paid Media in global and regional forums, including our bi-weekly global Paid Media meeting. Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness. WHO YOU ARE This role is fully remote and open to candidates based in Brazil. All team members may join occasional in-person meetings or offsites, about once or twice per quarter. A B2B paid media leader with at least 7 years of hands-on experience driving growth and strategy through paid channels. A results-driven marketer with a proven record of managing budget and goals at scale, who looks past CPL and CPA to lead quality, MQL-to-SQL conversion, and pipeline. A people leader with experience managing paid media team members and leading B2B paid media strategy. A multi-channel B2B expert with proven success on Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta, and LinkedIn, including audience segmentation. Experienced with a CRM such as HubSpot, and aware of how tracking and conversion setup affect campaign optimization. A curious, test-and-learn builder with hands-on experience using AI tools (such as Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini) and platform AI features, and the judgment to know when to trust AI output and when to check it. An analytical thinker with strong skills in Google Sheets or Excel (models, forecasts, pivot tables) and BI tools such as Tableau or Looker Studio. A self-starter with a strong sense of ownership who solves problems and works well both independently and in a team in a fast-growing company, across time zones (UK, Brazil, US, Argentina). A confident communicator with advanced English (written and spoken) and presentation skills. English is mandatory, as our global team works in English. We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in B2B paid media (Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta, LinkedIn), advanced English, and experience managing paid media teams are mandatory requirements. WHAT WE OFFER YOU With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs! Our benefits include: WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you. WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content. HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance. FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office. FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines. PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday! PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled. CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success. CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here. Want to see what it’s really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube ! Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong. Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We’re proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. Read more about it here. Questions on how we treat your personal data? See our Aviso de Privacidade para Candidatos. #LI-HYBRID

title: GPU Compute Partnerships & Commercial Operations Manager
description: About Nebius : Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure. Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI. Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D. The role We’re looking for a GPU Compute Partnerships & Commercial Operations Manager to secure and manage the external GPU capacity that enables our inference business to serve customers and grow. Working closely with GTM, technical, and finance teams, you’ll translate commercial demand into provider sourcing priorities, help secure commercially attractive capacity, and manage provider agreements throughout their lifecycle. Your work will help ensure that capacity availability, deployment timelines, and provider economics support customer commitments and business objectives. You’ll own day-to-day commercial and operational coordination with compute providers — from evaluating proposals and progressing agreements to managing capacity changes, validating service delivery, and ensuring accurate billing. You’re welcome to work remotely from the United States . Your responsibilities will include: Align compute supply with commercial demand: Work with GTM and technical teams to understand expected customer demand, deployment requirements, and timing, and translate these into external capacity sourcing priorities. Source and evaluate compute partners: Identify and assess GPU providers based on pricing, available capacity, deployment timelines, service reliability, and suitability for customer inference workloads. Support commercial negotiations: Compare proposals and help negotiate rates , capacity commitments, payment terms, service levels, and remedies that support the economics and delivery requirements of the inference business. Drive agreements to execution: Coordinate Legal, Finance, Procurement, Security, and technical stakeholders through review, approval, signature, provider onboarding, and purchase order creation, keeping timelines aligned with planned deployments and customer commitments. Manage ongoing compute partnerships: Serve as a primary commercial and operational contact for providers , coordinating capacity changes, service escalations, renewals, and contractual follow-through as business needs evolve. Reconcile provider performance: Review monthly availability and SLA reports against contractual commitments and internal monitoring data. Work with providers and technical teams to resolve discrepancies and capture applicable service credits. Manage billing accuracy and commercial adjustments: Validate charges against agreed rates, billable capacity, service periods, and delivered service . Resolve billing disputes and ensure contractual credits and adjustments are reflected. Coordinate timely payments: Work with Finance and Accounts Payable to ensure approved invoices are paid on time and outstanding issues are resolved, supporting continuity of critical capacity relationships. Maintain visibility into capacity and commitments: Track contracted capacity , spend, payment schedules, renewal dates, notice periods, provider performance , and open issues to inform commercial planning and upcoming capacity decisions. We expect you to have: Experience in infrastructure partnerships, commercial operations, technology sourcing, or vendor management supporting a commercial business. Strong commercial judgment and the ability to connect capacity availability, provider terms, and service performance to customer delivery and business economics. Experience coordinating agreements across Legal, Finance, Procurement, and technical teams. Confidence working with pricing, contractual commitments, operational data, invoices, and service credits. Strong project management and communication skills, with the ability to drive progress across teams without direct authority. Comfort with infrastructure concepts and translating technical requirements into commercial and operational actions. Attention to detail in reconciling discrepancies and maintaining clear records of obligations, decisions, and adjustments. It will be an added bonus if you have: Experience with GPU compute, cloud infrastructure, data center services, or other capacity-based technology partnerships . Familiarity with inference workloads and the factors affecting capacity requirements and unit economics . Experience supporting capacity planning in a customer-facing or GTM environment. Experience administering SLAs, availability calculations, service credits, and consumption- or commitment-based billing. Familiarity with contract management, procurement , and accounts payable systems. What success looks like: External GPU capacity is secured in time to support customer deployments and commercial demand. Provider pricing and commitments support the inference business’s commercial objectives. Agreements and internal approvals progress in line with deployment timelines. Provider issues and capacity changes are resolved with clear ownership and follow-through. Monthly service delivery and invoices are reconciled accurately, with applicable credits and adjustments captured. GTM, technical, and finance teams have clear visibility into available and committed capacity, spend, and upcoming provider decisions. Key employee benefits in the US: Health insurance: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and families. 401(k) plan: Up to 4% company match with immediate vesting. Parental leave: 20 weeks paid for primary caregivers, 12 weeks for secondary caregivers. Remote work reimbursement: Up to $85/month for mobile and internet. Disability & life insurance : Company-paid short-term, long-term and life insurance coverage. #LI-VC1 Pay Transparency We offer competitive compensation and benefits packages. Actual compensation will be determined based on job-related factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, the level at which the candidate is hired, and geographic location, consistent with applicable law. Base Compensation Range $160,000—$200,000 USD Benefits & Perks: Competitive compensation Career growth and learning opportunities Flexibility and ownership Collaborative and innovative culture Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects International environment and talented teams What's it like to work at Nebius: Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI Equal Opportunity Statement: Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire. If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

title: Principal Revenue Strategist
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As a Principal Revenue Strategist, you'll help shape how GitLab brings its products to market as artificial intelligence changes how software is built and bought. Reporting to the VP of Revenue Strategy, you'll be a senior individual contributor connecting market, product, and field insights to clear recommendations and changes in how we sell. You'll take on complex, open-ended go-to-market questions with limited context, working directly with executive partners across Sales, Finance, and Product to decide where to invest, how to reach customers, and what needs to change.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Shape revenue strategy across customer segmentation, sales coverage, sales motions, and investment priorities.</li> <li>Design multi-quarter changes in how we sell and monetize, defining the implications for the customer journey, metrics, roles, incentives, and operating model. Build agreement on the path forward and partner with Field Operations and Enablement on execution.</li> <li>Develop market and expansion strategies, prioritizing markets, defining go-to-market models and capacity needs, and identifying the operational dependencies of entering or scaling in new regions.</li> <li>Connect go-to-market strategy and Product by translating field and customer insights into product input, and product direction into commercial implications. Relevant experience and transferable skills matter more than a particular career path.</li> <li>Direct experience solving business-to-business software go-to-market problems, such as segmentation, coverage, pipeline and conversion, sales capacity and productivity, incentives, or pricing and packaging.</li> <li>A structured approach to testing assumptions and turning an unclear problem into a framework, a recommendation, and practical next steps.</li> <li>Strong commercial and analytical judgment, including the ability to build models and recognize when the evidence is sufficient to make a decision.</li> <li>The ability to work credibly with senior leaders, challenge decisions with evidence, and influence people without formal authority.</li> <li>A collaborative, hands-on approach that treats execution as part of strategy, not a handoff after the recommendation.</li> <li>Helpful, but not required: experience with usage-based or consumption models, international expansion, enterprise or platform sales, or a technical or scientific background. title: Senior CX Platform Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As a Senior CX Platform Engineer, you'll help GitLab's Customer Experience (CX) teams hand real work to artificial intelligence (AI). You'll use Claude Code and GitLab Duo Agent Platform as your default development tools, designing agentic workflows and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers with production testing, security, and shared ownership. This is a software engineering role, not ticket-taking internal IT, AI evangelism disconnected from shipped code, or customer-billable Professional Services delivery.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Use Claude Code, GitLab Duo, and other coding agents as your primary development environment for planning, implementation, refactoring, testing, reviews, and documentation. Run multiple agents in parallel on well-scoped tasks, critically review their output, and own every line that reaches production.</li> <li>Build and maintain the team's agent harness, including shared AGENTS.md conventions, skills, slash commands, hooks, subagent definitions, and continuous integration checks. Measure and share what works, publish reusable patterns, and retire those that don't.</li> <li>Ship agents and multi-step workflows for account research, success planning, scoping, status reporting, and customer onboarding. Package them as skills and plugins for non-engineers using Claude, Claude in Slack, and GitLab Duo Agent Platform.</li> <li>Build MCP servers and connectors for governed access to GitLab, Salesforce, Gainsight, Kantata, Thought Industries, Gong, Snowflake, and other enterprise systems. Add evaluations, tracing, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints to keep internal and customer-facing agents measurable, auditable, and safe with customer data.</li> <li>Evolve the CX Application Platform's gateway, Amazon Web Services (AWS) infrastructure, including Elastic Container Service (ECS), Relational Database Service (RDS), and Lambda, Terraform configuration, application scaffold, and deployment path. Own applications such as PS Compass, Congregate, and GitLab University and its integrations, documenting build-versus-buy and consolidate-or-sunset decisions.</li> <li>Ship production-quality Python and TypeScript through GitLab continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), with tests, observability, security review, and runbooks. Design every application for handoff, with documentation, monitoring, and shared ownership.</li> <li>Prototype with Customer Success, Digital Success, Professional Services, Education Services, and Training in days, not quarters. Help CX team members bring their own applications to production, and turn field learning into reusable reference implementations, development paths, and enablement.</li> <li>Contribute upstream to GitLab and share product feedback with Product and Engineering. Mentor engineers and non-engineers on agentic development and raise the team's code review bar.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience building and operating production software, owning multi-quarter work from ambiguity to production, choosing reusable platform solutions over one-off customization where appropriate, and designing for handoff.</li> <li>Daily, hands-on use of coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GitLab Duo, or similar on production work. You can show how they've changed what you ship and how you maintain quality.</li> <li>Experience building with large language models (LLMs) beyond chat, including tool use, MCP servers, agent loops, context and retrieval design, prompt and workflow design, and evaluations.</li> <li>Strong Python skills with FastAPI or Flask and TypeScript skills with Vue or React, including application programming interface (API) design, authentication, authorization, and secure handling of customer and business data.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with AWS ECS, RDS, and Lambda, Terraform, Docker, and applications running behind single sign-on (SSO), such as Okta.</li> <li>Experience integrating enterprise systems through Representational State Transfer (REST) and GraphQL APIs, and fluency with Git, merge requests, and CI/CD.</li> <li>Experience translating non-engineering stakeholders' workflows into technical plans and writing clear asynchronous design documents, decision records, and enablement materials. You align with GitLab's values and are willing to use GitLab for your own work.</li> <li>Optional experience includes agent harness customization; the GitLab Development Kit, Duo Agent Platform custom agents and flows, or AI Catalog publishing; enterprise agent governance and data controls; customer success, professional services, or learning platforms such as Salesforce, Gainsight, Kantata, or Thought Industries; professional services economics and customer success metrics; Snowflake or similar warehouses; and technical writing, talks, or open source contributions on agentic development.</li> </ul> <p>We welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; you don't need to meet every nice-to-have to apply.</p> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>CX Platform Engineering builds and runs CX Applications for Customer Success, Digital Success, Professional Services, Education Services, and Training. title: Senior CX Platform Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As a Senior CX Platform Engineer, you'll help GitLab's Customer Experience (CX) teams hand real work to artificial intelligence (AI). You'll use Claude Code and GitLab Duo Agent Platform as your default development tools, designing agentic workflows and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers with production testing, security, and shared ownership. This is a software engineering role, not ticket-taking internal IT, AI evangelism disconnected from shipped code, or customer-billable Professional Services delivery.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Use Claude Code, GitLab Duo, and other coding agents as your primary development environment for planning, implementation, refactoring, testing, reviews, and documentation. Run multiple agents in parallel on well-scoped tasks, critically review their output, and own every line that reaches production.</li> <li>Build and maintain the team's agent harness, including shared AGENTS.md conventions, skills, slash commands, hooks, subagent definitions, and continuous integration checks. Measure and share what works, publish reusable patterns, and retire those that don't.</li> <li>Ship agents and multi-step workflows for account research, success planning, scoping, status reporting, and customer onboarding. Package them as skills and plugins for non-engineers using Claude, Claude in Slack, and GitLab Duo Agent Platform.</li> <li>Build MCP servers and connectors for governed access to GitLab, Salesforce, Gainsight, Kantata, Thought Industries, Gong, Snowflake, and other enterprise systems. Add evaluations, tracing, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints to keep internal and customer-facing agents measurable, auditable, and safe with customer data.</li> <li>Evolve the CX Application Platform's gateway, Amazon Web Services (AWS) infrastructure, including Elastic Container Service (ECS), Relational Database Service (RDS), and Lambda, Terraform configuration, application scaffold, and deployment path. Own applications such as PS Compass, Congregate, and GitLab University and its integrations, documenting build-versus-buy and consolidate-or-sunset decisions.</li> <li>Ship production-quality Python and TypeScript through GitLab continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), with tests, observability, security review, and runbooks. Design every application for handoff, with documentation, monitoring, and shared ownership.</li> <li>Prototype with Customer Success, Digital Success, Professional Services, Education Services, and Training in days, not quarters. Help CX team members bring their own applications to production, and turn field learning into reusable reference implementations, development paths, and enablement.</li> <li>Contribute upstream to GitLab and share product feedback with Product and Engineering. Mentor engineers and non-engineers on agentic development and raise the team's code review bar.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience building and operating production software, owning multi-quarter work from ambiguity to production, choosing reusable platform solutions over one-off customization where appropriate, and designing for handoff.</li> <li>Daily, hands-on use of coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GitLab Duo, or similar on production work. You can show how they've changed what you ship and how you maintain quality.</li> <li>Experience building with large language models (LLMs) beyond chat, including tool use, MCP servers, agent loops, context and retrieval design, prompt and workflow design, and evaluations.</li> <li>Strong Python skills with FastAPI or Flask and TypeScript skills with Vue or React, including application programming interface (API) design, authentication, authorization, and secure handling of customer and business data.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with AWS ECS, RDS, and Lambda, Terraform, Docker, and applications running behind single sign-on (SSO), such as Okta.</li> <li>Experience integrating enterprise systems through Representational State Transfer (REST) and GraphQL APIs, and fluency with Git, merge requests, and CI/CD.</li> <li>Experience translating non-engineering stakeholders' workflows into technical plans and writing clear asynchronous design documents, decision records, and enablement materials. You align with GitLab's values and are willing to use GitLab for your own work.</li> <li>Optional experience includes agent harness customization; the GitLab Development Kit, Duo Agent Platform custom agents and flows, or AI Catalog publishing; enterprise agent governance and data controls; customer success, professional services, or learning platforms such as Salesforce, Gainsight, Kantata, or Thought Industries; professional services economics and customer success metrics; Snowflake or similar warehouses; and technical writing, talks, or open source contributions on agentic development.</li> </ul> <p>We welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; you don't need to meet every nice-to-have to apply.</p> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>CX Platform Engineering builds and runs CX Applications for Customer Success, Digital Success, Professional Services, Education Services, and Training. We own the CX Application Platform's gateway and infrastructure alongside our application portfolio: GitLab University, the Foundational Onboarding Agent in GitLab Duo Agent Platform, Congregate, PS Compass, and Customer Wins. We build the first version with the people doing the work, turn what we learn into a reusable pattern, then hand it off so it runs without us. We reward leverage, not heroics, and don't leave tools dependent on one person.</p> <h4><br><br></h4><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. Product-led-Funnel KI-native Arbeitsweise in Content, Design und Analyse Was wir dir bieten Ein echtes Mandat: Verantwortung für Marke und Wachstum eines ganzen Unternehmens, siebenstellige Budgetverantwortung, als Teil des Führungsteams. Für diese Rolle bedeutet das regelmäßige Präsenz in unserem Stuttgarter Office, immer mit ausreichend Vorlauf. KI ist unsere Arbeitsweise: Zugang zu führenden KI-Tools ist bei uns Standard, nicht etwas, das du beantragen musst. Wir ermutigen ausdrücklich zur intensiven Nutzung in Content, Design, Analyse und Reporting. Work-Life-Balance: Wir wollen nicht, dass du an deinem Schreibtischstuhl festwächst. B. Stuttgart und Barcelona 2026), dazu regelmäßige Team-Events und Culture Days. Arbeiten im Ausland: Bei Flip AI kannst du auch aus dem EU-Ausland arbeiten. Lass uns im Gespräch über Remote Work sprechen. Damit unsere Stellenanzeigen leichter lesbar sind, verwenden wir im Textverlauf die männliche Form der Anrede. Bei Flip AI sind alle willkommen, ganz egal, welches Geschlecht du hast oder wie alt du bist. Sexuelle Identität, Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung und Behinderungen spielen keine Rolle. Das Wichtigste ist, dass DU zu uns passt! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: Mit über 650 Kolleg:innen an 19 Standorten in ganz Deutschland gestalten wir bei teccle die Zukunft der IT. Seit 2020 bringen wir starke IT-Unternehmen mit unterschiedlichsten Schwerpunkten unter einem Dach zusammen - und entwickeln uns so zu einem der führenden IT-Dienstleister im Land. Unser Ziel: IT-Lösungen schaffen, die wirklich weiterhelfen - verständlich, flexibel und zukunftsfähig. Für unsere Kund:innen und gemeinsam mit einem Team, das Technik genauso liebt wie neue Ideen. Als Teil der teccle group steht die Braintower Technologies für innovative IT-Security- und Netzwerklösungen, sichere Business-Kommunikation sowie ganzheitliche Managed Services – von der Konzeption über die Implementierung bis zum laufenden Betrieb. Zur Verstärkung unseres dreiköpfigen IT-Security-Teams, das in einer Remote-First-Kultur zusammenarbeitet, suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt engagierte Unterstützung. Was du bei uns bewegst Bei uns zählt nicht nur, was du kannst - sondern auch, was du bewirkst. In dieser Rolle trägst du zu folgenden Punkten bei: Schutz der IT-Systeme, Netzwerke und Daten unserer Kund:innen vor Cyberangriffen und Sicherheitsrisiken Analyse aktueller Cyberbedrohungen sowie Optimierung von Sicherheitslösungen zur Erkennung bekannter und neuer Angriffsmuster Durchführung von Schwachstellenanalysen mit Tenable (Nessus & Exposure Management) sowie Beratung unserer Kund:innen bei der Bewertung und Behebung von Sicherheitslücken Auswahl, Implementierung und Überwachung von IT-Sicherheitslösungen in den Bereichen SIEM, SOC, EDR und NDR , beispielsweise mit Microsoft Defender und Huntress Unterstützung bei der Umsetzung von Sicherheitsmaßnahmen rund um Identity & Access Management (IAM), Zertifikatsinfrastrukturen und Cyberabwehr Weiterentwicklung der IT-Sicherheitsarchitektur unserer Kund:innen sowie Dokumentation sicherheitsrelevanter Systeme und Prozesse Bearbeitung und Nachverfolgung von Security-Tickets über Jira (perspektivisch ServiceNow) sowie Einsatz von Tufin SecureTrack im Netzwerk-Sicherheitsmanagement Womit du bei uns glänzt Niemand erfüllt jede Anforderung. Wenn du neugierig bist und Lust auf die Aufgabe hast, freuen wir uns auch dann auf deine Bewerbung, wenn nicht alles zu 100% passt. Du bringst Berufserfahrung im Bereich IT-Security sowie gute Kenntnisse in LAN-/WAN-Netzwerken und Firewall-Lösungen mit, idealerweise mit Fortinet Du hast praktische Erfahrung im Vulnerability Management und im Umgang mit Schwachstellenscannern wie Tenable Nessus, Microsoft Defender oder OpenVAS Du kennst dich mit Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR/XDR) aus und hast idealerweise bereits mit Microsoft Defender XDR gearbeitet. Du verfügst über Grundkenntnisse in der Administration von Windows- und Linux-Servern und bist mit der Netzwerktechnik vertraut Du arbeitest eigenständig , proaktiv und lösungsorientiert , kommunizierst klar und schätzt die Zusammenarbeit im Team sowie den direkten Kundenkontakt Du kannst mit IT-Security-Zertifizierungen wie Microsoft SC-200, CompTIA Security+, CySA+ oder Fortinet-Zertifizierungen zusätzlich punkten Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und gut auf Englisch - im Team, mit Kund:innen und im Alltag Du lebst in Deutschland und bist berechtigt hier zu arbeiten - so können wir im Alltag gut und reibungslos zusammenarbeiten Darauf kannst du dich freuen Bei uns bekommst du mehr als nur einen Job. Wir wollen, dass du dich weiterentwickeln, wohlfühlen und mitgestalten kannst. Hier ein paar Gründe, warum du gerne bei uns arbeitest: Mehr Freiheit: 30 Tage Urlaub, flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Orientierung an unseren Servicezeiten (7–17 Uhr) und bis zu 25 Tage arbeiten im EU-Ausland Arbeiten, wie es zu dir passt: Ob im Büro oder von zuhause - du entscheidest, was für dich am besten funktioniert Wissen, das weiterbringt: Zertifizierungen, individuelle Weiterbildungen und Raum für deine Entwicklung Willkommenskultur mit Herz: Ein kollegiales Team und echtes Miteinander Gutes Arbeitsumfeld: Moderne Technik und klare Strukturen Sichere und faire Konditionen: attraktives Gehalt, JobRad, betriebliche Altersvorsorge und Unterstützung über meinEAP, unser kostenloses Beratungsangebot - auch für deine Familie Vielfalt macht uns stärker - deshalb fördern wir bewusst ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem alle Menschen willkommen sind. Unabhängig von sozialer oder ethnischer Herkunft, Geschlecht, Alter, Religion oder Weltanschauung, Behinderung, sexueller Identität und Orientierung: Wir bieten allen Bewerbenden einen fairen Prozess und gerechte Chancen. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen, die unsere Haltung zu Vielfalt, Gleichberechtigung und Inklusion teilen – und Lust haben, gemeinsam mit uns eine inklusive Arbeitswelt zu gestalten. logs, traces, dashboards, and alerts.</li> <li>Contributing to a modular monolith, bounded context, shared component, or independently operated service.</li> </ul> <div As a BDR at GitLab, you get the opportunity to lead the initial outreach to targeted accounts working in conjunction with the Field and Digital Marketing teams as well as the Sales and Customer Success teams. In this role you'll leverage creative marketing and sales tactics to prospect and engage with multiple buyer personas and roles to introduce GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform. Many have worked in closing roles previously or managed teams.</p> <p>We have an extensive onboarding and training program at GitLab and you'll be provided with necessary DevOps and GitLab knowledge to fulfill your role.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Execute outbound prospecting initiatives to generate qualified meetings and pipeline in your assigned territory.</li> <li>Generate New Logo opportunities and Growth opportunities on existing customer accounts.</li> <li>Conduct high-level discovery conversations with target accounts to understand business needs, qualify opportunities, and create Sales Accepted Opportunities (SAOs).</li> <li>Meet or exceed monthly and quarterly BDR-sourced Sales Accepted Opportunity (SAO) targets (e.g., Stage 1 and Stage 3 opportunities) by consistently converting qualified prospects into opportunities.</li> <li>Research and prioritize target accounts using business and industry knowledge to identify key players, uncover compelling events, and develop tailored outreach strategies.</li> <li>Execute a multi-touch outreach cadence (call, email, social, etc.) to all prospects in your assigned territory using Outreach to maximize engagement and conversion rates.</li> <li>Manage, track, and accurately report all prospecting activities and pipeline in Salesforce to provide clear visibility into performance and forecast.</li> <li>Collaborate with Field, Corporate, and Digital Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success teams to build targeted account lists, campaigns, and call strategies. Attend regional marketing events to engage participants, generate leads, and drive qualified Sales Accepted Opportunities (SAOs).</li> <li>Document and continuously improve Business Development Representative processes in the GitLab handbook in partnership with your Business Development Manager. Mentor new BDR hires to help them ramp quickly and navigate key accounts.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Previous tech industry experience in an outbound sales development role is required.</li> <li>Positive and energetic phone skills, excellent listening skills, strong writing skills.</li> <li>Ability to prioritize tasks, manage a high volume of outreach, and consistently follow through on prospecting activities.</li> <li>Proven experience taking initiative, persisting through setbacks, and independently driving projects or activities through to successful outcomes.</li> <li>Alignment with our values and working in accordance with those values.</li> <li>Knowledge of business process, roles, and organizational structure.</li> <li>Proficiency in using Salesforce, Sales Navigator, and Outreach or similar prospecting and sequencing tools.</li> <li><span style="font-size: 10pt;">The ability to travel for events such as trainings, team offsites, customer meetings, etc.</span></li> <li>Proficiency in English, our company language, is required for effective communication.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>As part of GitLab's growing Sales team, you will work closely with the Field and Digital Marketing teams, as well as the Sales and Customer Success teams. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. title: Senior Third Party Risk Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not only about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo.</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰£85,000 - £115,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a>  ✨<br><br></p> <p><strong>⭐️ Our Third Party & Outsourcing Risk Management Team</strong></p> <p>We are a high-performing Global team focused on delivering pragmatic Third Party Risk Management (‘TPRM’) that protects Monzo and our customers globally. As Monzo expands across new markets and scales its product range, the operational footprint is growing fast, and the operating environment is becoming more complex.</p> <p>We’re looking for a <strong>Senior Third Party Risk Manager </strong>to help shape and deliver our approach.  As well as ensuring Monzo’s TPRM has well defined controls, processes and governance models in place to meet the continually growing and evolving demands of global Third Party Risk Management regulations - you’ll also set priorities and turn them into measurable improvements.</p> <p>Reporting to the Director of Third Party Risk, this is a <strong>hands-on </strong>role, with strategic scope. You’ll work across the global team, and with a variety of stakeholders throughout Monzo, to strengthen our framework, manage complex risks and improve how we deliver TPRM both tactically and strategically. </p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Delivering Core TPRM Operations Globally</strong>: Operating end-to-end operational activities, including supplier tiering, materiality assessments, due diligence reviews, exit planning support, and regulatory reporting.</li> <li><strong>Driving Operational Excellence:</strong> Taking ownership of process quality, making sure TPRM activities are completed accurately, consistently and on time. You’ll look for ways to improve how we manage third party risk in practice.</li> <li><strong>Helping shape our priorities: </strong>Identifying emerging risks, gaps and opportunities across third party risk management, and making recommendations to inform the team’s strategy and roadmap. You’ll develop practical solutions and help deliver improvements through to completion.</li> <li><strong>Enabling Strategic Delivery:</strong> Supporting and feeding into higher-level strategic initiatives and complex risk landscapes. Leading agreed initiatives from problem definition through implementation autonomously, working across teams and global markets to deliver measurable improvements and ensuring clear visibility throughout.</li> <li><strong>Collaborating Across Teams:</strong> Working directly with internal stakeholders across the 3LOD, and external suppliers to clear blockers, follow up on actions, and resolve issues effectively.</li> <li><strong>Sharing your expertise:</strong> Support colleagues and stakeholders with practical guidance, helping them understand how to deliver their third party risk responsibilities.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>You know Outsourcing, Third Party Risk & Regulation: </strong>You have substantial practical TPRM experience (ideally in banking or financial services) operating in both the UK and EU financial markets.  </li> <li><strong>You’ve contributed to a risk strategy, framework or operating model: </strong>You can demonstrate how you translated an identified gap into a practical improvement.</li> <li><strong>You’re comfortable leading complex assessments:</strong> You make balanced, well-reasoned recommendations when information is incomplete or stakeholders have different priorities.</li> <li><strong>You have experience working with various technologies</strong>: TPR tooling and AI to build innovative solutions and streamline operational workflows.</li> <li><strong>You hold a high quality bar:</strong> You pay close attention to detail and care about accuracy. You use data and reporting to spot patterns, make evidence-based decisions and improve processes.</li> <li><strong>You take ownership:</strong> You work independently, take initiative and prioritise your workload in a fast-moving environment. You use sound risk judgement and know when to seek guidance or involve others.</li> <li><strong>You focus on outcomes, not just activity: </strong>You measure success by what has materially improved whether that's faster turnaround times, clearer risk ownership, or cleaner supplier data.</li> <li><strong>You are a clear, pragmatic communicator: </strong>You build strong relationships with internal teams, third parties and regulators. You’re comfortable holding colleagues accountable and offering constructive challenges when needed. You bring together input from specialists across Information Security, Data Protection, Legal and Operational Resilience to form a clear view of risk.</li> <li><strong>You are comfortable escalating: </strong>You use sound judgement to know when to involve your team or manager in emerging issues or concerns, and communicate your priorities and workload clearly and regularly, defaulting to transparency and taking accountability.<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £85,000 - £115,000  ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London)</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.<br><br></p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 3 key steps</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li>Short call with a Monzo Recruiter</li> <li>Video-call with the Hiring Manager</li> <li>Full-Loop Interviews (1 x Role Specific + 1 x Behavioural)<br><br></li> </ul> <p>📆 <strong>Please Note</strong>: We pause hiring from 14th Dec 2026 - 4th January 2027. </p> <p><strong>Full Loop interviews will take place in January 2027 🥳Thanks for your patience!</strong></p> <p>⏳We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo.<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo"> You can read them here.</a></p> <p> </p> <p>#LI-REMOTE</p> <p>#CM-1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage.</p></div>
