title: Customer Success LATAM
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As a Customer Success Manager for Latin America (LATAM), you’ll help GitLab customers in the region realize the full value of our development, security, and operations (DevSecOps) platform by driving adoption, measurable outcomes, and long-term advocacy. You’ll serve as a trusted advisor to a portfolio of customers, guiding them on Git, branching strategies, the software development lifecycle, continuous integration, continuous deployment, and DevSecOps best practices.</p> <p>This role requires more technical depth than a typical Customer Success Manager role, but not the same level of technical expertise as a Customer Success Engineer. You’ll need to learn and use GitLab hands-on, triage technical questions, and guide customers on product and infrastructure best practices, while keeping adoption and business outcomes at the center of your work.</p> <p>In this role, you’ll connect customer goals with GitLab capabilities, lead workshops and Centers of Excellence efforts, and translate product usage data into clear, actionable recommendations for both customers and GitLab account teams. You’ll collaborate closely with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and Professional Services, with success in your first year measured by customer satisfaction, retention, and the strength of the strategic relationships you build.</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Build and maintain a trusted advisor relationship with each assigned customer in LATAM, focusing on adoption, measurable outcomes, and long-term satisfaction with GitLab.</li> <li value="2">Triage customers’ technical questions, provide product and infrastructure best practices, and help customers establish a GitLab Center of Excellence within their organization.</li> <li value="3">Lead workshops and provide hands-on product enablement to help customers understand and use the full value of the GitLab solution across their software development lifecycle.</li> <li value="4">Measure and monitor customers’ progress against critical and key performance indicators, and share insights with GitLab account stakeholders and customer sponsors and executives.</li> <li value="5">Translate customer product usage data into clear, actionable recommendations that drive adoption and expansion of GitLab within customer environments.</li> <li value="6">Establish and manage regular touchpoints with customers in line with service level agreements to review strategic and technical objectives and adjust plans as needed.</li> <li value="7">Collaborate closely with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and Professional Services to streamline issue resolution, share customer feedback, and align on customer success plans.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Business-level fluency in English, Spanish, and Portuguese.</li> <li value="2">Familiarity with the LATAM market.</li> <li value="3">Experience across the full customer journey, including post-sales adoption, value realization, and advocacy.</li> <li value="4">Background in customer success, professional services, technical account management, or a related function with direct customer engagement.</li> <li value="5">Ability to understand and discuss Git, common branching strategies, and how customers use version control in their workflows.</li> <li value="6">Knowledge of the software development lifecycle, including typical development pipelines and tooling.</li> <li value="7">Ability to learn and use GitLab, triage technical questions, share product and infrastructure best practices, and provide hands-on product enablement for customers.</li> <li value="8">Basic-to-intermediate knowledge of development and operations (DevOps), including familiarity with continuous integration, continuous deployment, and DevSecOps concepts and practices.</li> <li value="9">Skill in translating product usage data and technical details into clear, actionable insights for both technical and executive stakeholders.</li> <li value="10">Proven ability to build trusted relationships with customers and coworkers, facilitate workshops, and guide customers through best practices and operational change.</li> <li value="11">Ability to manage multiple customer needs simultaneously and maintain clear, thorough documentation.</li> <li value="12">Commitment to learning and growing, with a willingness to investigate questions and work through problems independently.</li> <li value="13">Transferable skills from adjacent roles or industries that support collaborative, outcome-focused customer partnerships.</li> </ul> <h3>Nice to have</h3> <ul> <li value="1">Prior experience at a startup.</li> <li value="2">Prior experience at a GitLab competitor.</li> <li value="3">Intermediate-to-advanced DevOps knowledge.</li> <li value="4">Prior experience leading executive-level conversations.</li> <li value="5">Prior experience selling services.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The Customer Success Management team at GitLab works with customers across regions to drive adoption of the GitLab DevSecOps platform, measure and communicate outcomes, and build long-term advocacy. In this role, you’ll support customers in LATAM as part of a globally distributed, all-remote team. We collaborate asynchronously with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Professional Services, and other groups to connect customer needs with GitLab’s product and services. We focus on helping our customers establish GitLab best practices, including Centers of Excellence, and on turning usage data into actionable insights that support strategic and technical objectives.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our <a class="waffle-rich-text-link" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/" data-sheets-formula-bar-text-link="https://bit.ly/GLBeneUS" data-sheets-formula-bar-text-style="font-size:12px;color:#1155cc;font-weight:normal;text-decoration:underline;font-family:''Arial'';font-style:normal;text-decoration-skip-ink:none;">benefits</a><span data-sheets-formula-bar-text-style="font-size:12px;color:#000000;font-weight:normal;text-decoration:none;font-family:'Arial';font-style:normal;text-decoration-skip-ink:none;"> and </span><a class="waffle-rich-text-link" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/stock-options/" data-sheets-formula-bar-text-link="https://bit.ly/GLequity" data-sheets-formula-bar-text-style="font-size:12px;color:#1155cc;font-weight:normal;text-decoration:underline;font-family:''Arial'';font-style:normal;text-decoration-skip-ink:none;">equity</a>. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.</em></p></div><div class="title">United States Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$93,600</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$158,400 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a>

title: Senior Product Manager, Salesforce CRM
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p><strong>An Overview about the Role</strong></p> <p>We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the Lead-to-Opportunity (L2O) domain within our Salesforce and GTM technology ecosystem. This role sits at the intersection of marketing operations, sales process, and technology owning the roadmap for how leads are captured, scored, routed, and converted into pipeline, and how our broader GTM tech stack supports that motion.</p> <p>This is a foundational hire one of the first product managers on a team actively transforming from a reactive BSA model into a proactive, roadmap-driven product organization. You'll be both an individual contributor driving your own domain and a mentor helping BSAs grow into product manager roles. You'll have direct influence over how we shape the team's future operating model.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Do</strong></p> <p><strong>Internal Product Roadmap Ownership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Define, own, and maintain the multi-quarter internal product roadmap for the Lead-to-Opportunity domain covering lead capture, enrichment, scoring, routing, conversion, opportunity and the broader GTM technology stack integrated with Salesforce</li> <li>Translate business strategy from Marketing, Sales Development, RevOps, and GTM leadership into sequenced, prioritized system capabilities with clear outcomes and success metrics</li> <li>Define the domain's strategic priorities each quarter and half, balancing net-new capability delivery, stabilization, and technical debt reduction with transparent trade-off frameworks</li> <li>Drive quarterly planning ceremonies, partnering with Engineering Managers and BSAs to align capacity with roadmap commitments</li> <li>Own domain-level documentation: process maps, current-vs-future state lead lifecycle flows, and decision logs that keep stakeholders and the team aligned on scope and ownership</li> </ul> <p><strong>Stakeholder Partnership & Requirements Translation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as the primary product voice for all L2O and GTM Systems initiatives, partnering closely with Marketing, Marketing Operations, SDR/BDR leadership, Sales, and RevOps</li> <li>Lead discovery, requirements workshops, and business process design sessions translating complex GTM and marketing operations requirements into actionable system specifications</li> <li>Own the decision layer between "what the business needs" and "what engineering builds," resolving ambiguity with structured frameworks and documented decisions</li> <li>Run structured stakeholder alignment sessions to surface trade-offs, build consensus, and drive open decisions to closure rather than letting them linger</li> <li>Represent the domain in cross-team planning and leadership reviews able to explain technical constraints to business stakeholders and business context to engineers</li> </ul> <p><strong>Team Mentorship & Capability Building</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as a product craft mentor and senior thought partner for the BSA team, actively upskilling analysts in product thinking, requirements structuring, acceptance criteria definition, and roadmap communication</li> <li>Model and codify what "good" looks like reusable templates, rituals (backlog grooming, roadmap reviews), and a rubric BSAs can grow against</li> <li>Give BSAs increasing ownership over pieces of the roadmap as they develop, with regular feedback and structured check-ins</li> <li>Partner with leadership to evolve the team's operating model from project-execution-focused to product-thinking-led, raising the bar for how EntApps delivers business value</li> </ul> <p><strong>Program Strategy & Delivery Oversight</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead initiatives end-to-end: discovery, requirements, prioritization, solution design review, UAT, launch, and post-launch measurement</li> <li>Write and maintain clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and lead-flow and data-flow diagrams that engineering and admins can build against without ambiguity</li> <li>Manage a healthy, well-groomed backlog intake requests from Marketing and Sales Development, triage by impact and effort, and defend prioritization decisions to stakeholders</li> <li>Define success metrics per initiative (lead response time, routing accuracy, lead-to-opportunity conversion rate, data quality, SDR/BDR adoption) and report on outcomes, not just delivery</li> <li>Identify and de-risk dependencies across adjacent domains campaign operations, data enrichment vendors, opportunity handoff to sales before they block delivery</li> <li>Own UAT strategy and acceptance criteria in collaboration with BSAs, ensuring system changes meet business requirements before production release</li> </ul> <p><strong>Systems Architecture Collaboration</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner with Enterprise Architects and Engineering Managers on Salesforce and MarTech integration design marketing automation platform to Salesforce sync, data enrichment pipelines, lead scoring and routing engines, ensuring choices hold up to governance, scale, and future roadmap needs</li> <li>Bring informed opinions on GTM platform architecture trade-offs based on deep domain knowledge</li> <li>Stay current on platform roadmaps for Salesforce Sales Cloud and connected MarTech tools, identifying opportunities to leverage native capabilities before custom builds</li> <li>Maintain domain-level R&R clarity, who owns what across US/India technical managers, BSAs, and adjacent pods and update as team and scope evolve</li> <li>Ability to engage deeply with engineering and architecture teams on API design, data modeling, and integration patterns.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You'll Bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>7+ years in Salesforce product management, business systems analysis with demonstrated growth into product ownership</li> <li>Strong working knowledge of Lead-to-Opportunity processes; lead capture, scoring, routing, and conversion and how they connect marketing execution to sales pipeline</li> <li>Hands-on familiarity with the GTM technology stack: Salesforce Sales Cloud plus marketing automation platforms (Marketo, HubSpot, or Pardot), lead scoring and routing tools, and data enrichment or intent providers</li> <li>Good Understanding of quoting process </li> <li>Demonstrated ability to own and communicate multi-quarter internal product roadmaps to senior business and technology stakeholders</li> <li>Proven experience leading initiatives Agents can generate code and tests in seconds, but passing tests don't always mean the software works as intended. You'll contribute to validation approaches and feedback mechanisms that help agents catch that gap and self-correct while they work.</p> <p>This isn't a quality assurance or test automation role. We’re looking for someone who has built with agents, run into the gap between passing tests and working software, and wants to help close it.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own backend features from design through production rollout, making the design calls within the architecture the team agrees on.</li> <li>Build agentic code-review and validation workflows that check whether generated code does what was intended, not just whether its tests pass.</li> <li>Prototype focused validation and feedback mechanisms with your teammates, and use what you learn to improve the platform.</li> <li>Develop language-aware validation approaches, starting with Rust, Ruby, and Go, adapting techniques to each language while applying a shared definition of trusted software to assess whether agent-generated code delivers the intended behavior.</li> <li>Implement feedback that helps agents identify problems and self-correct during development.</li> <li>Collaborate with engineering teams to test these approaches in real workflows, measure adoption, engineer trust, and validation quality, and use those measurements to evaluate improvements.</li> <li>Participate in code and design reviews, explain implementation trade-offs, and seek feedback on your work.</li> <li>Take part in on-call or operational support where your team's ownership model requires it.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience building software with artificial intelligence agents and understanding why their output can pass tests yet fail to behave as intended, from encountering that gap yourself or building something to prevent it.</li> <li>Backend development experience in at least one of Rust, Ruby, Go, or Python, with openness to working across languages.</li> <li>Experience taking backend features from design into production, discussing implementation trade-offs, and knowing when to ask for guidance.</li> <li>Comfort working inside a large existing codebase, not only on greenfield projects.</li> <li>A practical approach to prototyping, learning from results, and turning useful ideas into working software.</li> <li>Clear written communication and the ability to collaborate in an all-remote, asynchronous environment.</li> <li>The ability to share decisions transparently and improve your work through iteration and feedback.</li> <li>Familiarity with containerized services; Kubernetes experience is a plus.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Trusted Agentic Development team sits within GitLab's Developer Experience group and builds the platforms our engineers rely on every day. We work across engineering teams and programming languages to understand how people use agents, test new approaches in real workflows, and create a shared model of trusted agentic development that teams choose to adopt.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong><em>Poland base salary range:</em></strong><em> zł 248,000 - zł 372,000</em></p> <p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the EU, applicable in the specified country or countries only. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As Director, Social Media, you'll lead GitLab's global social media strategy and help people understand how GitLab is co-creating the future of software development. The role shapes how GitLab shows up across social channels, connecting our company, product, and employer stories, to build meaningful engagement with customers, users, contributors, candidates, and industry audiences. Expect to set clear priorities, guide execution, and use insights to strengthen GitLab's voice and business impact. You'll own the outcomes of GitLab's social function — strategy, budget, team development, tooling, and results — and serve as GitLab's senior-most voice on social strategy with executive stakeholders.</p> <p>This is a player-coach role. You'll set the strategy and stay close enough to the work to write, build, and ship alongside the team. Two Social Media Managers report to the head of corporate communication and work with you on a dotted-line basis. You'll set their strategic direction, raise the editorial and craft bar, and develop them as practitioners, including goal-setting, feedback, and career development in partnership with their manager. Influence matters in this role, which is why it calls for someone who has already led and grown social practitioners. </p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own the performance of GitLab's social function and its contribution to marketing and business goals.</li> <li>Lead GitLab's global organic social media strategy, channel plans, and editorial priorities.</li> <li>Own GitLab's YouTube strategy end to end — channel architecture, programming and series development, long- and short-form video, packaging (titles, thumbnails, metadata), search and recommendation optimization, and subscriber and watch-time growth.</li> <li>Partner with Growth Marketing on paid social, including briefing creative, aligning organic and paid on shared audiences and messaging, informing boosting and amplification decisions, and connecting paid performance back to organic strategy.</li> <li>Develop clear, audience-focused campaigns that support company, product, brand, and talent goals.</li> <li>Guide content planning and publishing across social channels while maintaining a consistent GitLab voice.</li> <li>Own the social media budget, tooling stack, and agency, freelance, and production partner relationships.</li> <li>Partner with teams across Marketing, Communications, Product, Sales, Talent Acquisition, and other functions to plan and deliver social programs.</li> <li>Build processes that support effective collaboration in GitLab's all-remote, asynchronous environment.</li> <li>Use social listening, audience insights, and performance data to improve content and inform broader marketing decisions.</li> <li>Lead the measurement framework for social — KPIs, dashboards, and reporting cadence — and report performance and learnings to marketing and executive leadership.</li> <li>Partner with DevRel on community engagement to help GitLab participate in relevant industry conversations with a clear, useful point of view.</li> <li>Build and run creator, influencer, and advocacy programs, including developer creators, GitLab community contributors, and team member advocacy.</li> <li>Own GitLab's employee advocacy program — grow participation across Marketing, Sales, Engineering, and Talent, equip team members with content worth sharing, and measure reach, engagement, and contribution to brand and talent goals. Partner with Communications and Talent Acquisition on enablement, and manage the advocacy platform and its adoption.</li> <li>Support executive and expert social presence, partnering with Communications to help GitLab leaders and technical experts show up credibly on social, including constructive conversations with C-suite executives about proposed content.</li> <li>Apply AI tools thoughtfully across the social workflow to help GitLab model what an AI-native marketing team looks like.</li> <li>Prepare for and guide responses to sensitive or fast-moving issues in partnership with the appropriate teams.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>10+ years in social media, including at least 5 years leading social strategy for a global brand at the senior manager level or above, and accountable for the function's results.</li> <li>Experience owning a social function end to end, including strategy, budget, headcount, tooling, and results as the accountable leader. </li> <li>Experience leading teams, agencies, and cross-functional programs, with clear ownership of and accountability for outcomes.</li> <li>Depth in YouTube strategy, including owning and growing a brand or business channel, and can speak to programming decisions, video formats, packaging, and the metrics that actually move a channel.</li> <li>Hands-on experience growing LinkedIn and X as primary channels, with judgment about what content, format, and cadence work on each.</li> <li>Experience with paid social programs and how organic and paid social reinforce each other, including creative for paid, audience strategy, and interpreting paid performance data.</li> <li>Experience connecting social media programs to broader brand, communications, product, or business priorities.</li> <li>Strong editorial judgment and the ability to turn complex topics into clear, engaging content.</li> <li>Fluency with short-form and long-form video as core social formats, including working with production partners and creators.</li> <li>Experience defining a measurement framework for social, including KPIs, dashboards, and reporting cadence, and presenting performance, learnings, and recommendations to executive leadership on a standing basis.</li> <li>Experience building or scaling an employee advocacy program, including driving adoption across multiple functions, sustaining participation beyond launch, and reporting attributed reach and business contribution</li> <li>Fluency with an enterprise social stack for publishing, listening, and advocacy. Ours is Sprout Social, Meltwater, and EveryoneSocial.</li> <li>Experience running social programs across multiple regions and languages, and judgment about what to localize versus centralize.</li> <li>Skill in managing multiple priorities and making sound decisions in fast-moving situations.</li> <li>A collaborative, inclusive approach and the ability to work effectively in a distributed, asynchronous environment.</li> <li>Passion about GitLab's mission and the future of software development, open source, artificial intelligence, and DevSecOps.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>This role is part of GitLab's Marketing organization and works across teams to present a clear, consistent company voice on social media. The team collaborates asynchronously with partners across regions and functions, balancing planned campaigns with timely engagement. Together, you'll help audiences understand GitLab's platform, mission, values, and impact.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. title: Staff Backend Engineer, Database Automation (Go)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As a Senior or Staff Backend Engineer with the <a class="textLink" href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/data-engineering/database-excellence/">Database Excellence group</a>, you'll build and evolve database automation and PostgreSQL as a service capabilities for GitLab. The level will be determined during the hiring process. You'll use Go to automate the full lifecycle of PostgreSQL across GitLab's infrastructure, making database operations safer, more consistent, and easier to scale for databases that sit behind high-throughput, always-on internet services. You'll work closely with partner teams to shape how GitLab provisions and manages PostgreSQL in a fully remote, highly collaborative environment.</p> <p>Some examples of our projects:</p> <ul> <li value="1"><a class="textLink" href="https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/database-team/traffic-replay-poc">SQL Traffic Replay Tooling</a>, which validates upgrades and changes against real production workloads.</li> <li value="2"><a class="textLink" href="https://gitlab.com/groups/gitlab-org/database-team/backend/-/work_items/1">PostgreSQL as a Service Platform</a>, which provides standardized, automated provisioning and lifecycle management for internal product databases.</li> <li value="3"><a class="textLink" href="https://gitlab.com/groups/gitlab-com/gl-infra/data-access/dbo/-/work_items/75">PostgreSQL Major Version Upgrade Automation</a>, which supports safe, repeatable major upgrades at GitLab.com scale.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Design, build, and maintain Go-based automation that manages the full PostgreSQL lifecycle, including provisioning, configuration, upgrades, failover, scaling, and decommissioning, reducing reactive operational work that currently takes more than 80% of the team's time.</li> <li value="2">Build automation that works across infrastructure-as-code tooling and cloud infrastructure, and evaluate operator-based approaches as the platform evolves.</li> <li value="3">Use AI agents as a regular part of building and operating services, including implementation, review, and reducing repetitive work, while keeping the context agents need in the repository so the whole team can build on it.</li> <li value="4">Build for internet scale by designing automation and services for high-throughput, always-on production workloads, where GitLab.com traffic sets the bar for correctness, latency, and availability.</li> <li value="5">Integrate compute, storage, networking, identity and access management, and managed data services across cloud providers into one coherent PostgreSQL platform instead of creating bespoke setups for each database.</li> <li value="6">Build GitLab's PostgreSQL as a service platform to replace bespoke database setups with standardized, automated provisioning and lifecycle management, so supporting more databases doesn't require growing the operations team at the same rate.</li> <li value="7">Collaborate closely with product management, infrastructure, software delivery, and other engineering teams to design and ship high-performing solutions.</li> <li value="8">Research, design, and implement improvements to PostgreSQL performance, scalability, and data health, helping maintain more than 8 months of operational runway for all critical database saturation points.</li> <li value="9">Review database automation and Go changes from other engineers and contributors, with attention to safety, maintainability, and performance.</li> <li value="10">Document automation practices, PostgreSQL operational patterns, and guidance that helps engineers use and contribute to the platform.</li> <li value="11">Build safe, repeatable automation for PostgreSQL major version upgrades at GitLab.com scale, validating changes against real production traffic before rollout.</li> <li value="12">Operate what you build in production from end to end, using production feedback to guide each iteration.</li> <li value="12">Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Professional software engineering experience working with PostgreSQL in large, complex production environments, including experience building or operating a database-as-a-service product.</li> <li value="2">Proficiency with Go, including designing, implementing, testing, and reviewing backend services.</li> <li value="3">Experience developing Kubernetes operators, controllers, or similar automation for the lifecycle of stateful services, especially databases. Kubernetes experience is one way to demonstrate this skill, but isn't required; comparable experience building database or infrastructure automation is welcome.</li> <li value="4">Comfort with infrastructure as code and core database operations concepts such as high availability, replication, backups, and system-level performance trade-offs.</li> <li value="5">Familiarity with Ruby is a plus but isn't required. Much of GitLab's application codebase uses Ruby on Rails, and being able to read it helps when designing automation that application teams depend on. We’ll expect you to become comfortable with it on the job, not on day one.</li> <li value="6">Strong written communication skills and comfort working asynchronously in an all-remote, distributed team.</li> <li value="7">Self-directed work style with effective organizational skills, the ability to manage priorities as a "manager of one," and alignment with GitLab's values of transparency, collaboration, inclusion, and open source contribution, as well as its <a class="textLink" href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/operating-principles/">operating principles</a>.</li> <li value="8">Ownership of the technical direction for a major initiative such as the PostgreSQL as a service platform, turning an ambiguous problem into an architecture and a sequenced plan that several engineers can execute in parallel.</li> <li value="9">Influence beyond the team, setting the patterns other engineers follow, partnering with sibling database, infrastructure, and platform teams, and growing engineers through design reviews and mentorship.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The <a class="textLink" href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/data-engineering/database-excellence/">Database Excellence group</a> keeps GitLab’s databases running reliably through proactive health management, operational excellence, and strategic enablement. We maintain operational runway by identifying and addressing saturation points, operate infrastructure through automated and scalable processes, and provide tools and frameworks that help teams build features sustainably. Our primary focus is GitLab.com, and we're expanding our scope to provide database health frameworks and tooling that benefit self-managed customers as well.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p>As an Intermediate Backend Engineer on the GitLab Orbit team, you'll help build and operate a graph data service that supports GitLab Duo agents, analytics, and architecture-level features across GitLab.com, Dedicated, and Self-Managed deployments. You'll join a Rust-first team that values clear ownership, thoughtful system design, and rigorous thinking about data and reliability.</p> <p>The Knowledge Graph service is a Rust backend that builds a property graph from GitLab’s software development lifecycle (SDLC) and code data. It uses ClickHouse, NATS JetStream, and the Data Insights Platform. It exposes secure graph queries and MCP tools used by AI agents and product features. In this role, you’ll deliver features and improvements in well-scoped areas, learn the broader architecture, and contribute to reliability, observability, and operational readiness.</p> <p>In your first year, you’ll take clear ownership of specific components or features (for example, parts of the SDLC indexing pipeline or query paths). You’ll help reduce single points of failure with better tests and runbooks, and you’ll help the team ship analytical services that are easier to maintain and evolve over time.</p> <p><strong><strong class="textBold">What you’ll do</strong></strong></p> <ul> <li value="1">Implement and iterate on backend features in the Rust-based Knowledge Graph service, including changes to the query engine, SDLC and code indexing flows, and API endpoints (including MCP endpoints) under guidance from senior and staff engineers.</li> <li value="2">Maintain integrations between Knowledge Graph and the rest of the GitLab platform, working in areas that touch GitLab Rails, the Data Insights Platform (Siphon, NATS, ClickHouse), and GitLab Duo Agent Platform.</li> <li value="3">Contribute to system design discussions by proposing options, raising questions, and documenting decisions, with a focus on reliability, scalability, and maintainability for analytical graph workloads.</li> <li value="4">Improve the operational maturity of the service by adding or enhancing metrics, logging, runbooks, alerts, and small readiness tasks, and by participating in on-call rotation as appropriate for your level and experience.</li> <li value="5">Collaborate asynchronously with product, data, infrastructure, security, and AI counterparts to clarify requirements, align on scope, and ship features safely for customers and sustainably for the team.</li> <li value="6">Use AI-assisted development workflows responsibly (for example, using Knowledge Graph-backed agents and internal Duo tooling), and share what works with the team while keeping a strong focus on code quality and correctness.</li> <li value="7">Participate in code reviews, knowledge-sharing sessions, and pairing to both learn from others and help maintain consistent standards across the codebase.</li> <li value="8">Contribute across the stack when needed, including occasional Ruby work for Rails integration and authorization paths, or small frontend changes related to Knowledge Graph features (for example, Software Architecture Map UI plumbing).</li> <li value="8">Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.</li> </ul> <p><strong><strong class="textBold">What you’ll bring</strong></strong></p> <ul> <li value="1">Professional experience building and maintaining backend systems in production, with an understanding of reliability, maintainability, and how to support services over time (for example, incident response and follow-ups).</li> <li value="2">Proficiency in at least one modern backend language and strong interest in Rust, with either prior Rust experience or clear evidence you can ramp quickly and deliver in a Rust-first, performance-sensitive codebase.</li> <li value="3">Some exposure to distributed data or analytics systems (for example, OLAP databases, Kafka- or NATS-style messaging, or change data capture (CDC) pipelines), or strong motivation to develop those skills in this role.</li> <li value="4">Interest in graph data modeling and query patterns (property graphs, multi-step (n-hop) traversals, aggregations), and willingness to learn the tools and concepts used in Knowledge Graph over time.</li> <li value="5">Practical experience (or strong interest) using AI tools in day-to-day development, along with a thoughtful approach to validating outputs and integrating AI into your workflow.</li> <li value="6">A language-agnostic mindset and evidence that you can pick up new languages and frameworks as needed (for example, Ruby, Go, or TypeScript/Vue where the work touches adjacent systems).</li> <li value="7">Solid fundamentals in system design for your level, including the ability to reason about trade-offs, ask good questions, and align your implementation work with documented architectural decisions.</li> <li value="8">Comfort working in a low-process, high-ownership environment where you take responsibility for your work, refine problem statements with teammates, and communicate progress clearly in writing across time zones in an all-remote team.</li> </ul> <p><strong><strong class="textBold">About the team</strong></strong></p> <p>GitLab Orbit sits within the Data Engineering organization. We work closely with partners across AI (Duo Agent Platform), analytics, infrastructure and delivery, and security because our work spans many parts of the platform.</p> <p>We collaborate asynchronously rather than following a feature factory model. and Engineering leadership on platform roadmap decisions and investment trade-offs.</li> <li value="8">Mentor Senior and Intermediate engineers, reduce technical debt, build reusable patterns that data-sheets-root="1">Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.</span></li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">A record of leading technical work across more than one team or a broad product area.</li> <li value="2">Deep backend architecture and production experience with complex applications, services, or platforms, including application programming interfaces, service platforms, data systems, modular monoliths, or shared backend components.</li> <li value="3">Experience modernizing a monolith or legacy backend architecture in production and using modular approaches such as bounded contexts, package encapsulation, ports and adapters, service extraction, or event-driven boundaries.</li> <li value="4">Experience building alignment through clear written proposals and decision records so teams document, understand, and adopt technical decisions.</li> <li value="5">Experience making code review, documentation, and practice.</li> <li value="7">Production experience with artificial intelligence-assisted or agentic engineering workflows, including improving how a team adopts title: Recruiter, R&D (AMER)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p><strong>An overview of this role</strong></p> <p>As a Technical Recruiter, you'll help GitLab build the engineering and product teams behind our DevSecOps platform. strategy and address hiring issues.</li> <li>Assess technical candidates on depth of experience, scope and impact of past work, problem-solving, and open source or community contributions, and how well their skills fit GitLab's teams and technology.</li> <li>Build research-based, diversity-focused sourcing plans that balance applicants, passive talent, referrals, internal talent, and targeted outreach across technical communities and specialized talent pools.</li> <li>Deliver a thoughtful candidate experience through disciplined pipeline management, proactive communication, timely feedback, and offer negotiations that clearly explain compensation, equity, and benefits.</li> <li>Improve recruiting practices by sharing learnings and reusable resources, using artificial intelligence (AI) responsibly, and representing GitLab's mission, values, and culture.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you'll bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>Intermediate-level recruiting experience, with a track record of owning full-cycle searches independently.</li> <li>Technical recruiting experience, or a strong interest in learning engineering and product disciplines, tech stacks, team structures, and how software is built and shipped.</li> <li>Developing advisor skills: building stakeholder trust, influencing without authority, and managing hiring team expectations.</li> <li>Experience building proactive, diversity-focused sourcing strategies and balanced pipelines for hard-to-fill or specialized roles.</li> <li>A data-informed approach that turns funnel insights into practical actions.</li> <li>Strong organization across multiple requisitions and clear written and verbal communication across time zones, with attention to detail and candidate care.</li> <li>Experience with an applicant tracking system and recruiting tools such as Greenhouse, LinkedIn Recruiter, LinkedIn Insights, SeekOut, or comparable platforms; ability to evaluate AI-generated work, protect confidential information, and share responsible workflows with team members.</li> <li>Experience recruiting for DevSecOps, developer tools, or open source software is helpful, not required.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>We work in a globally distributed, remote-first Talent Acquisition team where clear communication and reliable follow-through matter. title: Senior Data Analyst - Acquisition
description: Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)? Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy? Then Pennylane is the right place for you ! Our vision We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones). We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business. About us Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!) In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to : 💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants 💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more... 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor . 🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe 🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings 🚀 Already more than 1 300,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France! WHY this position is of utmost importance to reach our mission At Pennylane, every decision that is not backed by data is likely to be challenged (when data is available of course). This culture is embraced by the leadership team, and actively promoted everywhere. The role of the data team is to make this possible by treating data like a production asset, making it available company-wide, and using it proactively to improve Pennylane’s user experience. By joining us as a Senior Data Analyst, you will have a pivotal role in large projects, bringing your business sense and analytical thinking to help us meet our high delivery standards. HOW you will contribute to the company As a Senior Data Analyst, you will be part of the Science & Analytics team focused on Acquisition (5+ people), inside the Data department (40+ people). You will proactively use data to identify opportunities to grow our business or improve our processes. You will be a real sparring partner for Sales & Operation leaders, feed their strategy by anticipating the most important business questions, and leverage your data & statistical skills to answer them. You will steer decision‑making in your business area through rigorous analyses, navigating ambiguity and collaborating across domains when needed. You will drive our self-service approach to analytics, by understanding our colleague’s needs in their use of data, and promoting a data driven culture. The Science & Analytics team is also fully in charge of creating data models in the Data Warehouse (using dbt). You will contribute to shaping the Data Engineering roadmap to deliver the best experience for your colleagues on the data platform. WHAT you can expect from your life at Pennylane Within one month: You will learn everything about our company, our teams, and our vision during the first onboarding week. You will get familiar with our stack, and have delivered a few small projects which will give you a concrete taste of our tools & processes. You will be given time to meet your future stakeholders, and gain a deep knowledge of our product and operations. Within 3 months: You will be fully in charge of supporting your area of the business, prioritizing your tasks with decision makers. You will be confortable with our technical stack (Python, Redshift, DBT). You will contribute to larger cross-company projects. Within 6 months: You will proactively contribute to the team’s roadmap. You will work with engineers and data practitioners on improving our stack and data platform. You will share your learnings and best practices within the team. And beyond : the data team will continue growing with the company Which means: Opportunities to recruit and mentor new team members Increased accountability in project leadership Responsibilities to design and implement new processes, tools and best practices to make sure that your team works even more efficiently. Who are we looking for? You’re the right candidate if you: Have had previous experiences as Data Analyst, ideally in scale-up environments (5-6 years) Are seasoned working with SQL, DBT and data visualization tools Are comfortable collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders beyond the data team You have a strong business acumen and are seen as a trusted partner by your business stakeholders Have strong communication skills and are capable of articulating your ideas clearly Are fluent in English (French is a plus) What does the recruitment process look like? A first interview with our Talent Acquisition Manager A case study interview to discuss a topic closely related to one of our priorities (60 min) A past project interview to hear about your experience (60 min) An interview with our Tech & Product leaders to discuss our company culture (45 min) What do we do to make your work life easier 🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane 💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package 📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us 🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it ⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness 💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment 🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone 🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone. If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…) We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries. Who are we looking for ? To thrive at Pennylane, you need : -To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to) -To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment -To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders) -Sufficiently experienced to prioritize business-led actions on your day to day activity We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria. If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration. Important information for candidates Recruitment scam attempts are on the rise. We invite you to remain vigilant during your exchanges. Applications through official channels only : apply exclusively through our job postings published on our official platforms (career site, official partner pages). Always verify the sender's email address : our communications are sent from professional email addresses with the domains ----- or ----- style="min-height:1.5em"> We will never ask you for payment or financial information (bank details, payment for an interview, equipment purchases, etc.) as part of the recruitment process. If such a request is made to you, it is fraudulent. We invite you to not respond and to report it to us immediately . We also want to emphasize that we fully embrace diversity, equity and inclusion and that we’re doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment. We are committed to providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disabilities, or any other traits that make you who you are. If anything, diversity makes us a more fun place to work at. 🇫🇷 Données personnelles Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à : Notre data policy 🇬🇧 Personal Data Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more 🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren 🇪🇸 Datos personales Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. Puede oponerse en cualquier momento y solicitar la eliminación de sus datos escribiendo a Más información Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Enterprise Account Executive, DACH
description: At Sanity.io , we’re building the future of AI-powered Content Operations. Our AI Content Operating System gives teams the freedom to model, create, and automate content the way their business works, accelerating digital development and supercharging content operations efficiency. Companies like PUMA, Carhartt WIP, Anthropic, Just Eat Takeaway, Spotify, HiPP, and Mercedes AMG are using Sanity to power and automate their content operations. As an Enterprise Account Executive at Sanity, you'll own the full sales cycle, from identifying the right prospects to closing deals with some of Europe's most ambitious companies. You'll work closely with SEs, SDRs, and marketing to build genuine relationships with enterprise customers and help them understand the real business value of structured content. It's a role with real autonomy, clear progression, and strong earning potential at a company that just raised $85M and is scaling fast. What you would do Take warm opportunities from our SDR and Marketing teams and run with them, your job is to close, not to chase cold leads all day Get under the skin of every prospect: understand their real business challenges and show them exactly how Sanity solves them Pitch, negotiate, and close enterprise deals and get well rewarded when you do Map organisations from the inside out, building relationships across teams from developers to the C-suite Work through procurement and contracts without losing your mind (we'll help) Be the voice of the customer internally - your feedback shapes product, messaging, and strategy Keep your pipeline tight: accurate forecasting, clean Salesforce data, and deal reviews that actually reflect reality About you You're based in Germany and fluent in both German and English - You can close a deal in either language without breaking a sweat You've sold a complex SaaS product before and you know how to navigate technical buyers, marketing leaders, and enterprise procurement all at once You have experience selling into large enterprises and are comfortable managing big, multi-stakeholder deals from first call to signed contract You're genuinely curious, about technology, about your customers' businesses, and about finding smarter ways to sell You pick up new products quickly and can translate complexity into a compelling story You're honest, high-integrity, and the kind of person colleagues actually enjoy working with You thrive when things move fast and you're not waiting around for someone to tell you what to do What we can offer A highly-skilled, inspiring, and supportive team Positive, flexible, and trust-based work environment that encourages long-term professional and personal growth A global, multi-culturally diverse group of colleagues and customers Comprehensive health plans and perks A healthy work-life balance that accommodates individual and family needs Competitive location-based salary and stock options program Who we are Sanity.io is a modern, flexible content operating system that replaces rigid legacy content management systems. One of our big differentiators is treating content as data so that it can be stored in a single source of truth, but seamlessly adapted and personalized for any channel without extra effort. Forward-thinking companies choose Sanity because they can create tailored content authoring experiences, customized workflows, and content models that reflect their business. Sanity recently raised a $85m Series C led by GP Bullhound and is also backed by leading investors like ICONIQ Growth, Threshold Ventures, Heavybit and Shopify, as well as founders of companies like Vercel, WPEngine, Twitter, Mux, Netlify and Heroku. This funding round has put Sanity in a strong position for accelerated growth in the coming years. You can only build a great company with a great culture. Sanity is a 300+ person company with highly committed and ambitious people. We are pioneers , we exist for our customers , we are hel ved , and we love type two fun ! Read more about our values here! Sanity.io pledges to be an organization that reflects the globally diverse audience that our product serves. We believe that in addition to hiring the best talent, a diversity of perspectives, ideas, and cultures leads to the creation of better products and services. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or gender identity. #LI-ED1 Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: AI Solution Architect (m/w/d)
description: Als IT-Dienstleister treiben wir die Digitalisierung des öffentlichen Sektors voran und schaffen echten Mehrwert für Millionen Menschen in Deutschland. Wir können vieles richtig gut, aber eben noch nicht alles. Darum suchen wir immer wieder neue Kolleg:innen, die mit ihren Ideen, ihrem Können und Engagement etwas bewegen wollen. Fühlst du dich angesprochen? Dann gestalte Deine Welt zum Besseren und werde Teil unseres Customer Cluster Environment, Transportation & Energy. DEINE MISSION Als AI Solution Architect (m/w/d) gestaltest Du die KI-/ML-Gesamtarchitektur für komplexe Enterprise-Umgebungen in der Cloud mit Schwerpunkt Microsoft Azure. Du verbindest fundiertes Know-how in ML Engineering, RAG-Architekturen und MLOps, um KI-Lösungen produktionsreif, skalierbar und sicher umzusetzen. description: About Continuity At Continuity, we’re building AI-native solutions that are redefining how insurers assess, monitor, and act on risk in the €1T+ commercial insurance industry. In today’s world, insurers are expected to make complex, high-stakes decisions, often with outdated tools and fragmented data. We're rewriting that reality. Our platform combines specialized AI, structured data, and underwriting expertise to empower insurers with the clarity, speed, and confidence they need to take smarter risks, faster. As the trusted partner of leading commercial P&C insurers, Continuity enables underwriting teams to: Instantly detect and qualify risks Keep portfolios up to date in real-time Automate and accelerate decision-making from quote to bind Our SaaS platform turns complex and scattered data into a clear, actionable interface, allowing underwriters to focus on what matters most: client relationships, portfolio profitability, and precision at scale. Backed by a €10M Series A round in 2024, we are now scaling internationally and doubling down on innovation. With more than 50% of our team dedicated to R&D, we’re exploring the frontiers of AI in insurance, from intelligent agents to adaptive underwriting workflows, to fundamentally transform how insurance operates. Joining Continuity means joining a high-impact, fast-growing team where your work shapes the future of risk intelligence. We’re not just building better tools, we’re helping the industry operate with a new level of intelligence. What do we promote? Our strong commitments include to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute. Our cultural drivers {empathy, impact, innovation, and collaboration} guide us as we work together to create meaningful change. This is why we focus on the skills and potential you bring, rather than just your academic background or past experiences. We believe that talent is shaped by diverse life journeys, and we’re excited to see how yours can contribute to our team while uncovering new perspectives and opportunities for growth together! Role overview: Germany is not a test. It's a commitment. Our pipeline is live. Our first clients are onboard. The commercial momentum is real and we are now looking for the person who will turn that momentum into lasting, measurable client success. This is not a support role. This is a builder position. You will work in close partnership with our Head of BD DACH, owning everything that happens from the first client handshake through to long-term value delivery. You will be the operational backbone of our DACH expansion, the person who makes sure that what we promise, we deliver. If you thrive at the intersection of client trust, structured execution, and commercial impact, this role was designed for you. Location: Germany or France (flexible) Regular travel required across Europe and France Start by listening, then make it happen One of our core beliefs at Continuity is that the best outcomes start with the deepest understanding. In this role, that means genuinely listening to what our clients need, not just what they say, and translating it into action that creates real value. You will engage directly with senior decision-makers at leading insurers: CUOs, COOs, Heads of Underwriting. You will run workshops, challenge assumptions, and earn the kind of trust that turns a first contract into a long-term partnership. Your ability to hold the narrative in front of a room, and to listen carefully before you do, will define your impact. Responsibilities: Client Delivery & Deployment: Own the full client journey from needs assessment to operational go-live. You lead setup, coordinate with underwriters, facilitate workshops, and manage the client-facing narrative at every stage, with the rigour of a consultant and the energy of a builder. POV Process Management: Drive Proof of Value processes for prospects not yet signed. You structure the deliverables, challenge the risk alerts, and make sure every POV builds a compelling, data-backed business case. Paris / DACH Communication Bridge: You are the connective tissue between our German clients and our Paris delivery and product teams. Information flows clearly and nothing falls through the cracks - because you made sure of it. Legal & Admin Coordination: Handle the contractual volume that comes with opening a new market - NDAs, DPAs, GDPR - with rigor and efficiency. Commercial Expansion: Work alongside the Head of BD DACH to identify upsell and expansion opportunities within existing accounts. Every successful deployment is a potential success story, and you know how to build one. Product Feedback Loop: Collaborate with our technical team on platform configuration and bring client insights back into the product roadmap. You are the voice of the DACH market internally. Value Analysis: Turn platform data into high-impact business recommendations that demonstrate ROI, deepen relationships, and make clients want to expand. Make a measurable impact, from day one We don't hire for potential and then put people in a corner. We hire people who are wired to execute, to deliver, and to raise the bar. At 3 months, you will have full platform fluency, ownership of existing DACH accounts, and be fully embedded in our Paris workflows. At 6–9 months, you will be running deployments autonomously, driving a structured POV process, and identifying the first expansion opportunities in your accounts. We care about results. We also care about how you get there, with rigour, ownership, and the kind of positive energy that makes hard things look manageable. What you bring: 3 to 7 years of experience from a high-performance environment: Strategy, Ops, M&A, Consulting, or equivalent. We care about the standard you've held yourself to, not the logo on your CV. Strong quantitative skills: Excel and data analytics proficiency are non-negotiable. A data-crunch case study is part of our selection process - come prepared. Native or near-native German and fluent English are essential. French is a bonus. A Trusted Advisor posture: equally comfortable running a client workshop, analysing a dataset, and challenging a C-level assumption in the same afternoon. Startup appetite: you don't need a playbook to get started. You write your own. Output orientation: you take ownership, move fast, and close the loop, every time. Insurance experience is a bonus but not required. A structured 3-month onboarding will get you fluent in our industry, our platform, and our clients. We are one team, even across borders At Continuity, "We Are One Team" is not a value we put on a slide and forget. It is the operating principle that makes everything else possible. In this role, you will be the living proof of that principle across two geographies. You will bridge cultures, languages, and working styles, between Paris and Frankfurt/Munich, between product and client, between what was promised and what gets delivered. The ability to connect people, share context, and keep everyone moving in the same direction is not a soft skill here. It is a core competency. You will not be alone. You will have the full support of our Head of BD DACH, our Paris delivery teams, and our leadership, all of whom are invested in making the DACH market work. Build the future, with us Germany is the beginning of something larger. As the DACH market scales, so will your scope, your responsibilities, and your impact within the Revenue organisation. We are not looking for someone to hold the fort. We are looking for someone who sees what this market could become and has the drive, the rigour, and the entrepreneurial instinct to help us get there. title: Engineering Manager, Architecture Engineering: Async
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As Engineering Manager, Architecture Engineering: Async, you'll lead a distributed group of Site Reliability Engineers and Backend Engineers. You'll support their development and balance production reliability with platform projects, including zero-downtime Redis upgrades, support for single-tenant and cell-based deployments, and the move from queue-based job orchestration to a durable workflow engine.</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Lead, hire, and grow a team of site reliability engineers and backend engineers, supporting career development, promotions, and onboarding.</li> <li value="2">Own reliability for the job processing and caching platforms, including service-level objectives, error budgets, alerting, and weekly operational reviews.</li> <li value="3">Manage capacity planning, support escalations, and incident follow-ups, balancing operational work with roadmap projects and rescoping work when deadlines can't be met.</li> <li value="4">Run the team's part of GitLab.com's first-tier on-call rotation, including shift coverage, onboarding, and handovers, and serve as incident commander for high-severity incidents.</li> <li value="5">Drive zero-downtime Redis version upgrades and automate operating system patching and reboots.</li> <li value="6">Adapt job processing to run in single-tenant and cell-based deployments.</li> <li value="7">Own the migration from queue-based job orchestration to a durable workflow engine, defining the first use cases, a measurable migration path, and the roadmap.</li> <li value="8">Own quarterly planning and the team roadmap, and clarify shared operational responsibilities with partner teams, including Git storage.</li> <li value="8">Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Experience managing an engineering team delivering high-performance services at scale, ideally site reliability engineers or infrastructure engineers running production software as a service systems.</li> <li value="2">Technical depth in background job processing and caching technologies such as Redis and Sidekiq, sufficient to guide decisions about upgrades, capacity, and failure modes.</li> <li value="3">Experience managing reliability against service-level objectives, including defining service-level indicators, setting up burn-rate alerting, and planning capacity.</li> <li value="4">Experience running a 24/7 on-call rotation and coordinating high-severity incidents.</li> <li value="5">A track record of balancing operational work and incident follow-ups with roadmap projects, and pushing back on scope when deadlines can't be met.</li> <li value="6">Experience leading a fully remote team across time zones in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia-Pacific.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The Async team runs GitLab.com's background processing layer, from the Sidekiq infrastructure to the shared code that enqueues jobs. Product teams build the jobs; we keep the platform that runs them fast and reliable. Our Redis clusters support caching, sessions, rate limiting, queues, and shared state. We also support data durability through backup and restore verification, object storage, and operational support for Git repository storage. That work includes restore drills, capacity rebalancing, and provisioning. We staff GitLab.com's first-tier production on-call rotation in 8-hour shifts across the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia-Pacific, triaging every paging alert and bringing in the right team when needed.</p> <p> </p> <p class="p1"><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the EU, applicable in the specified country or countries only.
