title: Director of Platform Engineering [gn] – Data Intelligence Platform
description: About Actian Actian is the company behind the Data Intelligence Platform — an enterprise solution that helps organisations discover, govern, and trust their data at scale. Our platform connects metadata, data lineage, data quality, and business context into a single knowledge graph, enabling enterprises to turn raw data into reliable decisions and providing the trusted data foundation required for enterprise AI. We operate globally, move fast, and build for the long term. The Opportunity We are looking for an experienced Director of Platform Engineering or Director of DevOps to establish and lead our newly formed Platform Engineering organisation. This is a hands-on technical leadership position for an engineering leader who has successfully built and scaled platform or infrastructure teams within a technology product company. You will not simply inherit and manage an existing organisation. You will build the team, define its technical direction, establish its operating model, and remain closely involved in architecture and implementation. You should be someone who can move confidently between strategic decisions and hands-on engineering: designing infrastructure, reviewing code, implementing automation, solving complex production challenges, and setting engineering standards. We are an AI-first engineering organisation. We expect you to actively use AI technologies to accelerate engineering, automate infrastructure operations, and fundamentally rethink how platform teams work. This is a builder's role, not a traditional executive management position. What You Will Own: 1. Platform Engineering & Architecture Establish and lead the Platform Engineering organisation from the ground up. Design and implement scalable, reliable platform services supporting our data catalog, knowledge graph, and integration APIs. Define the architecture and engineering standards used across the organisation. Establish clear ownership boundaries and effective collaboration with product engineering teams. 2. Cloud Infrastructure & Deployment Design and deliver a cloud-agnostic deployment architecture across AWS, Azure or Google Cloud, and customer-managed on-premises and private-cloud environments. Build and maintain Kubernetes-based infrastructure in production. Own infrastructure as code using Terraform/Terragrunt and GitOps-based deployment using Argo CD or equivalent technologies. Ensure reliable installation, upgrades, maintenance, and supportability across different customer environments. Support restricted-network and air-gapped deployment scenarios where required. 3. AI-First Engineering & Infrastructure Operations Integrate AI agents into infrastructure operations, including incident triage, remediation, change validation, and reporting. Use AI coding assistants and development agents extensively in your own daily engineering work. Establish practical standards for AI-assisted engineering across the platform team. Identify opportunities to replace traditional tools and operational processes with AI-driven automation. Build the infrastructure required to support AI and ML workloads, including model-serving environments and associated data services. Ensure appropriate human oversight, security guardrails, and auditability for AI-driven operations. 4. Security, Compliance & Reliability Establish security and compliance practices supporting SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and GDPR. Ensure compliance with EU data residency and customer-specific security requirements. Implement automated compliance evidence collection and audit readiness. Establish observability, monitoring, incident management, and on-call practices. 5. Team Building & Leadership Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing Platform Engineering team. Define the team's structure, responsibilities, processes, and engineering culture. Remain technically involved while developing the team's capabilities and autonomy. Work closely with the SVP of Engineering and other technical leaders to align platform strategy with business and product priorities. What You Will Deliver in Your First 12 Months: Build and establish a high-performing Platform Engineering team with clear ownership and responsibilities. Deliver a portable deployment architecture supporting AWS, at least one additional public cloud, and customer-managed infrastructure. Establish infrastructure as code and GitOps delivery as standard engineering practices. Introduce AI agents into operational workflows, with measurable reductions in manual effort and operational overhead. Deliver scalable infrastructure foundations for our data catalog, knowledge graph, and integration APIs. Automate compliance evidence collection and improve audit readiness. Establish a reliable operating model covering observability, incident response, security, and cloud cost management. What You Bring: Leadership & Experience 10+ years of professional experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure Engineering, or SRE. At least 3 years of direct engineering management experience. Currently operating at Director of Platform Engineering, Director of DevOps, or an equivalent hands-on Director-level position. Demonstrated experience building and scaling engineering teams, rather than exclusively managing established organisations. A strong track record of delivering and operating production platforms within a technology product company. The ability to combine technical leadership with hands-on engineering execution. Technical Expertise Deep, hands-on production experience with Kubernetes. Strong infrastructure-as-code experience, particularly Terraform or Terragrunt. Proven experience implementing GitOps and CI/CD pipelines using Argo CD or comparable technologies. Strong AWS expertise and practical experience designing cloud-portable architectures. Experience with Azure or Google Cloud is highly desirable. Demonstrated experience with self-hosted or on-premises enterprise software deployments. Practical experience with SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, and data residency requirements. Experience with cloud cost optimisation, FinOps, and infrastructure efficiency. AI-First Mindset Extensive practical use of AI coding assistants, development agents, and AI-driven automation. Experience applying AI to engineering productivity and infrastructure operations. Ability to identify, implement, and govern AI-driven operational workflows. A forward-looking mindset about how AI will change platform engineering and infrastructure management. Leadership Approach Strong ownership and execution skills. Comfortable making technical decisions and taking responsibility for their outcomes. Able to build teams and systems from scratch. Clear communication and the ability to work across distributed international engineering teams. Comfortable working across US Eastern and Central European time zones. Nice to Have: Experience with enterprise data platforms, data catalogues, metadata management, or graph databases. Production experience across multiple cloud providers. Experience with air-gapped and restricted-network deployments. Infrastructure for AI/ML workloads, model serving, vector databases, or graph data stores. OpenTelemetry or comparable observability technologies. Privileged access management solutions such as StrongDM. How You Will Work: You will report directly to the SVP of Engineering and work closely with Product Engineering, Security, Customer Success, and Support. This is a fully remote position based in the US East Coast, UK, Germany, France, or Spain, subject to local employment eligibility. You should be able to maintain at least four hours of daily overlap with both US Eastern Time and Central European Time. Occasional travel for team offsites and company-wide meetings may be required. We value builders over theorists, ownership over hierarchy, and measurable outcomes over activity. If you have built and scaled a platform engineering organisation, remain technically hands-on, and believe AI should fundamentally change how infrastructure teams operate, we would like to hear from you. What We Offer: The chance to be part of an innovative, fast-growing company making a significant impact in the data management space. Collaboration with a passionate and diverse team. Competitive salary and benefits package. Flexible work arrangements (remote or hybrid). Opportunities for professional growth and development. Why Join Us? At Actian, we are passionate about innovation and teamwork. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, loves creating an efficient and welcoming workspace, and enjoys working closely with a talented team. Interested? We’d love to hear from you! Let’s discuss how you can contribute to our success while growing your career with us. We value diversity at our company. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying. title: Senior Product Marketing Manager (m/f/d)
description: Fitness is the one industry where customers actually enjoy using the product. Help us tell that story well. Own product positioning and messaging across our brands, creating clear, differentiated value propositions tailored to customer segments and markets. Help decide what gets built, and why. Build market sizing and segmentation, and work with product so what we build meets customer needs and drives growth. Shape packaging. Shape product packaging, working closely with Product, Pricing and Finance. Launch things properly. Own go-to-market for key launches, from sizing and planning through to enablement. Join early, before the build, so the commercial view shapes the product from day one. Build a repeatable launch process that makes every launch smoother than the last. Show what worked. Track adoption and conversion of new features and modules against the uplift we forecast. Where we hit it, find ways to do more. Where we didn't, learn why and feed it back into strategy. Your measures: product attachment, expansion MRR, win rate by segment and average deal value by product. Stay close to customers and competitors. Talk to customers directly, run buyer research and win/loss, and own our ICPs. Build competitive intelligence as a living asset, with an AI agent doing the heavy lifting. Equip Sales to win. Own the sales-facing narrative and build the tools: pitch narratives, battlecards, ROI calculators, case studies. Then see which ones get used and which ones move deals. Enable the sales team to tell the right story, and track whether they get used. Build it, don't brief it. Use AI to speed up research and prototype pages, calculators and demos yourself. Hand the best ones to the agency or web team to scale. Your profile 6+ years of experience in Product Marketing, Product Management or a commercially focused product role within B2B SaaS. Proven experience owning product positioning, messaging and go-to-market initiatives, including shaping packaging or pricing recommendations, with the ability to explain the commercial reasoning behind your decisions. Hands-on experience bringing products to market with defined targets and measurable outcomes, and a clear understanding of what worked and what didn't. Ability to build and communicate strong commercial value cases or ROI models. A hands-on approach to creating assets such as prototypes, pages and calculators: you build, test and improve rather than simply brief others. Practical experience using AI tools for research and content creation, with an understanding of their strengths and limitations. Confidence working with commercial data, including pipeline, win rates and product attachment, using tools such as HubSpot or Salesforce. Fluent German and English (C1 level). title: Candidate Experience Specialist, Contractor (AUS)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h4><strong>This is a contract opportunity*</strong></h4> <h4><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h4> <p>As a Candidate Experience Specialist, you'll shape how candidates experience GitLab from first touch through offer and handoff to our People Operations team. You'll be a key partner to Recruiters, hiring managers, and recruiting leadership, helping them execute hiring plans, coordinate interviews, and maintain accurate, transparent processes in our applicant tracking system and GitLab repositories. You'll act as a brand ambassador who embodies our values in every interaction, ensuring candidates receive timely, thoughtful communication and a consistent, high quality experience across a high volume of roles. You’ll focus on building strong relationships with hiring teams, improving and standardizing coordination workflows, and supporting GitLab's goal of hiring a qualified, diverse, and motivated team in our all-remote, global environment.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong>  </p> <ul> <li>Collaborate with Recruiters, hiring teams, and Recruiting leadership to understand and execute the hiring plan for each job requisition.</li> <li>Coordinate with Recruiters to maintain accurate, up-to-date hiring process information in the applicant tracking system and GitLab repositories.</li> <li>Manage candidate scheduling and act as the Recruiting Coordinator to organize interviews and keep hiring processes running smoothly.</li> <li>Ensure candidates receive timely, thoughtful, and engaging communication at each stage of the hiring process.</li> <li>Help manage candidate traffic for all roles, monitoring pipelines and flagging issues or bottlenecks to the recruiting team.</li> <li>Create and stage employment contracts for candidates receiving offers on behalf of hiring managers and Recruiters.</li> <li>Partner with People Operations to create a seamless handoff for new team members joining GitLab.</li> <li>Promote GitLab's values, culture, and all-remote approach in every interaction, acting as a brand ambassador for potential team members.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Bring </strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience supporting end to end hiring processes in partnership with recruiters and hiring managers, ideally in a fast paced or high volume environment.</li> <li>Skill using an applicant tracking system to schedule, track, and move candidates through interview stages; Greenhouse experience is beneficial but not required.</li> <li>Proficiency with Google Workspace, scheduling tools,  and a willingness to learn and use additional tools.</li> <li>Ability to communicate clearly and professionally in writing and verbally with candidates and internal stakeholders at all levels, including executives.</li> <li>Demonstrated strength in organization, time management, and prioritization, with a consistent focus on meeting deadlines and maintaining attention to detail.</li> <li>Ability to build collaborative relationships with team members across time zones and functions while maintaining a high level of confidentiality.</li> <li>Interest in learning about talent acquisition and contributing to an inclusive hiring process that attracts a qualified, diverse, and motivated team.</li> <li>Alignment with GitLab's values and comfort working in an all remote, asynchronous environment, including flexibility in your working hours to support candidates and hiring teams across multiple time zones, with openness to transferable experience from related coordination or operations roles.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>The Candidate Experience team partners with Recruiters, hiring managers, and People Operations to run a smooth, consistent, and inclusive hiring process across GitLab's all-remote, global organization. title: People Safety & Resilience Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h3><strong><strong class="textBold">An overview of this role</strong></strong></h3> <p>As a People Safety & Resilience Manager at GitLab, you'll help protect team members working from home, in Labs, and in coworking spaces. You'll turn GitLab's safety and resilience strategies into practical programs that work across countries, both day to day and when a crisis disrupts how people work.</p> <h3><strong><strong class="textBold">What you’ll do</strong></strong></h3> <ul> <li value="1">Run the occupational health and safety management system in line with ISO 45001. Put the global policy into practice through hazard identification, risk and ergonomic assessments, incident reporting and investigation, performance measurement, internal audits, and management reviews.</li> <li value="2">Identify and meet each country's legal safety obligations with Employment Law, People Compliance, Benefits, and local vendors. Track changes in the law and keep records of required appointments, assessments, committees, training, and medical surveillance. Manage vendor agreements and keep safety and resilience services within budget.</li> <li value="3">Coordinate required consultation with works councils and team members before GitLab makes a decision or contacts affected team members outside the consultation process. Prepare consultation materials, participate in health and safety committees where they exist, and retain the consent, hearing, and anonymized reporting records each jurisdiction requires.</li> <li value="4">Run the workplace violence prevention program. Coordinate the threat management team, train managers, and keep case records and legally required local plans up to date.</li> <li value="5">Coordinate crisis response and disaster relief. Keep the crisis plan and records current, with a lead and alternate for every role. During on-call shifts, follow escalation procedures and support the crisis team until the response ends. Work with the relief partner to track the Team Member Disaster Relief fund balance and handle communications and reporting.</li> <li value="6">Maintain continuity plans for the People Group, assess the impact of disruptions, and prioritize recovery of essential services. Keep records for auditors and insurers, run crisis and continuity exercises, lead required reviews after incidents, and track follow-up actions until they're complete.</li> <li value="7">Assess each requirement in ISO 45001, ISO 22361, and ISO 22301. Each week, review the scores produced by AI agents and correct any errors. Set deadlines for improvements and report quarterly on the safety and resilience measures in the People Safety & Security scorecard.</li> <li value="8">Lead people safety and crisis response on site at major company events alongside security operations. Confirm emergency procedures and medical arrangements are in place, serve as the crisis team's on-site contact, and lead a review after each event.</li> </ul> <h3><strong><strong class="textBold">What you’ll bring</strong></strong></h3> <ul> <li value="1">Experience delivering safety and resilience programs across several countries, covering occupational health and safety plus either crisis management or business continuity.</li> <li value="2">Knowledge of when to consult team members or works councils, hold hearings, or make decisions jointly, and how to document each step. To handle GitLab's legal obligations in Germany, you'll need direct experience applying the Betriebsverfassungsgesetz and Arbeitssicherheitsgesetz.</li> <li value="3">Ability to apply ISO 45001, ISO 22361, ISO 22301, the ANSI/ASIS workplace violence prevention standard, and the European Union framework directive on safety and health at work when drafting policies and procedures with legal and compliance partners and external advisers.</li> <li value="4">Experience managing programs across teams, including assigning owners and deadlines, tracking regulatory changes, and preparing records for audits.</li> <li value="5">Experience using artificial intelligence (AI) agents to draft materials, score assessments, and update records, and checking their results against the standards. Ability to keep that work repeatable by tracking changes to prompts and workflows in GitLab.</li> <li value="6">Ability to travel internationally up to 30% of the time to support company events, run exercises, and attend health and safety committee meetings in person. These commitments can fall in the evenings or on weekends.</li> <li value="7">Availability outside standard working hours as part of a scheduled on-call duty rotation and when the crisis management plan is activated, including evenings, weekends, and public holidays.</li> <li value="8">Experience managing consultations across Germany, the Netherlands, and France is strongly preferred because you'll work under each country's rules. Safety or business continuity credentials, ISO 45001 or ISO 22301 lead implementer or auditor qualifications, and works council or labor relations training are also helpful.</li> </ul> <h3><strong><strong class="textBold">About the team</strong></strong></h3> <p>We work with Employment Law, People Compliance, Benefits, the crisis management team, team member representatives, and external partners. You'll bring these partners together through plans with named owners and deadlines. Our People Safety & Security scorecard tracks how well we meet safety standards and legal duties and which consultations, exercises, and incident reviews we've completed. It also tracks whether we've reviewed continuity plans in the past twelve months and closed audit findings by their deadlines.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our <a class="waffle-rich-text-link" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/" data-sheets-formula-bar-text-link="https://bit.ly/GLBeneUS" data-sheets-formula-bar-text-style="font-size:12px;color:#1155cc;font-weight:normal;text-decoration:underline;font-family:''Arial'';font-style:normal;text-decoration-skip-ink:none;">benefits</a><span data-sheets-formula-bar-text-style="font-size:12px;color:#000000;font-weight:normal;text-decoration:none;font-family:'Arial';font-style:normal;text-decoration-skip-ink:none;"> and </span><a class="waffle-rich-text-link" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/stock-options/" data-sheets-formula-bar-text-link="https://bit.ly/GLequity" data-sheets-formula-bar-text-style="font-size:12px;color:#1155cc;font-weight:normal;text-decoration:underline;font-family:''Arial'';font-style:normal;text-decoration-skip-ink:none;">equity</a>. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.</em></p></div><div class="title">United States Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$115,200</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$194,400 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy

   AI / Management Consulting: Experience in a (boutique) consultancy, delivering AI or digital transformation projects with exposure to account management, client relationships, and business Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As an Executive Assistant at GitLab, you’ll help two senior leaders protect time for their priorities. You’ll primarily support a Vice President in Product and also support a Vice President in Marketing. You’ll manage both executives’ calendars, travel, and expenses.</p> <p>This all-remote role is open to candidates in the United States and Canada, with no preference for a specific time zone within those countries.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Manage both executives’ calendars across time zones, resolving scheduling conflicts before they disrupt priority meetings.</li> <li>Prepare a complete itinerary for each domestic or international trip, including flights, hotels, and any required visas.</li> <li>Submit and reconcile expense reports for both executives by each reporting deadline, following GitLab’s travel and expense policies.</li> <li>Coordinate recurring leadership activities with the Senior Executive Business Partner and keep shared office resources, distribution lists, Slack channels, and calendars up to date.</li> <li>Plan team events, offsites, and large meetings with partners across GitLab so schedules and logistics are in place before each event.</li> <li>Use artificial intelligence (AI) tools like Claude to capture meeting notes and reduce manual note-taking while protecting confidential information.</li> <li>Cover for other Executive Business Administrators by handling time-sensitive calendar, travel, and expense requests before they’re due.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience providing executive-level administrative support to multiple senior leaders at once and adapting to each leader’s needs.</li> <li>Proficiency with productivity, video meeting, team messaging, and travel and expense tools, and the ability to learn new tools quickly. We use Google Workspace, Zoom, Slack, and Navan. Experience with comparable tools, such as Microsoft Teams for messaging, is welcome.</li> <li>Sound judgment under pressure: you can work independently, stay composed when plans change, and know when to reprioritize or escalate competing executive requests.</li> <li>Experience planning offsites or comparable events, with the organization, clear communication, and attention to detail to coordinate with multiple teams.</li> <li>Experience using AI to improve day-to-day operations while keeping sensitive information confidential.</li> <li>Ability to build relationships and gather context remotely, with flexibility in your working hours to coordinate across regions. Experience supporting teams across offices or regions can transfer to this role.</li> <li>Ability and willingness to travel domestically and internationally to support executives, offsites, and key events. title: Financial Crime Lead
description: What is Finary? Money is broken: most people’s wealth sits in products they did not choose, with fees they cannot see. We are putting a private banker in everyone’s pocket, with the same quality of advice for a €10K saver and a €10M client. Mounir launched Finary in 2021, and more than 1M people now track their wealth with us. Finary AI turns that context into a plan, and our investment products and in-house wealth advisors (Finary One) make it real. Why now? AI makes this possible, and 3 things make it hard to copy: years of per-user financial data that no public dataset holds, a brand that brings in half of our new users through our own channels, and licences (PSAN, Investment Firm, MiCA) we secured before they became mandatory. We raised €40M from Hedosophia, Y Combinator and Speedinvest. Founders and leaders from Qonto, Photoroom, Bitpanda, UBS and Wise also invested. What we offer We’re 70 builders with real ownership from day 1, tier-1 salary and equity, and offices in central Paris with hybrid remote. Our culture is direct and built on radical candor. AI is a real bar here: everyone has rebuilt how they work around it. Read more about our values here . The opportunity More than 1M people track and grow their wealth with Finary. In 2021, when a simple registration was enough to offer crypto in France, we chose to build fully regulated. Today Finary is a crypto-asset service provider under MiCA, an investment firm, a payment institution and an insurance broker. Very few European platforms hold that combination. Our compliance team is organised by role, not by product: compliance officer, AML, senior advisory and control. Each role covers every licence. Reporting to our Head of Compliance, who is our AML/CFT officer, you'll work alongside our AML analyst and take ownership of the framework that protects our clients and our licences, with most of our exposure in crypto. What you'll do Lead the AML/CFT framework: procedures, client risk classification, detection rules and tools (screening, blockchain analytics, Travel Rule), calibrated on our own data. Investigate and decide the hard cases: enhanced reviews of individuals and companies (ownership chains, financial statements, flows), on-chain investigations, decisions on suspicion. Draft and file suspicious transaction reports, and act as deputy TRACFIN declarant and correspondent. Handle screening and asset freezing: PEP, sanctions and adverse media hits, list updates. Build with AI: design and tune the agents and rules in our back-office tool that prepare files and clear first-level reviews, and keep the decision on suspicion human. Work with Ops, Care, Product and our outsourced review team so that AML decisions are clear, fast and fair to the honest majority of our clients. What we're looking for You've spent 6 to 8 years in AML/CFT in financial services, including hands-on work at a crypto-asset service provider (PSAN/CASP). You've drafted and filed suspicious transaction reports with TRACFIN yourself. You investigate on-chain: you use blockchain analytics tools and you know the Travel Rule and self-hosted wallets. You hold a certification in on-chain analysis (Chainalysis CCI, CCCA or CRC, or a TRM Labs or Elliptic equivalent) and a Travel Rule certification (Notabene NB-TRFC or equivalent). You work with data and AI every day: you query data yourself and you already use AI in your reviews or investigations. This is a must, not a plus. You decide on evidence, you keep weak signals in proportion, and you explain your decisions clearly. You prioritise a growing queue by risk without missing a legal deadline, and you move the framework forward at the same time. Fluent French and professional English. This role is not for you if you'd rather stay on onboarding checks, you prefer advising to deciding, or you need a large financial crime department and mature tools before you can start. You don't tick every box? Apply anyway if you've done the core of the job: investigating cases, deciding them and filing the reports. Interviews Interviews with French-speaking candidates are held in French. As an international company, we expect a working level of English, which we test during the screening call. Compensation: €65K – €80K • Offers Equity • €65K – €80K • Offers Equity Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Software Engineer - Postgres Tooling
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a Software Engineer, Postgres Tooling to join our CLI team and help build the open-source tools developers use to change their Postgres schemas safely. You’ll join as a co-maintainer of pg-delta, our schema diff and migration engine, and grow into leading it. Given two databases, or a database and a folder of SQL files describing the schema you want, pg-delta works out the differences and generates the migration to get from one to the other. It powers supabase db diff, db pull, and declarative schemas, and it runs underneath Supabase’s platform, branching, and AI agent workflows. Every migration it generates is verified on a throwaway clone before it’s trusted, and it’s tested against 331 scenarios on PostgreSQL 14–18. We’re now working toward a stable, standalone 1.0 release for any Postgres developer, on Supabase or not. This is a correctness-first role. The SQL this tool generates runs against production databases, so privilege safety and avoiding data loss are non-negotiable. It’s a great fit for someone who loves Postgres at the catalog level, enjoys compiler-style problems, and thrives in async, fast-paced environments. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR In this role, you’ll: - Co-maintain pg-delta: review and merge changes, including PRs written by AI agents, and grow into its lead maintainer. - Own correctness: triage bug reports from GitHub and support, fix diff and dependency-ordering bugs, and extend test coverage across Postgres versions. - Make sure generated migrations are privilege-safe and never silently lose data, by detecting destructive changes and rewriting them into safe equivalents where possible. - Help take pg-delta to a stable 1.0: a public API with a semver contract, documentation, and broader coverage of Postgres extensions. - Work with the open-source community: triage issues, review outside contributions, and say no gracefully when a request doesn’t fit. - Work with the teams across Supabase that build on pg-delta, so migrations are generated and run the same way everywhere. - Write the design docs and technical strategy that set the tool’s direction, working async across teams. - Share the CLI team’s on-call rotation. Weekdays are covered follow-the-sun, and because we ship packaged software that users can roll back, pages are rare. YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU Must have: - Have 8+ years of experience as a software engineer, including deep, hands-on work with PostgreSQL. - Know Postgres internals at the catalog level: pg_catalog, pg_depend, object ownership, grants and default privileges, RLS policies, and extension membership. - Understand DDL and migration semantics: which changes take locks, which can’t run inside a transaction, how dependencies determine ordering, and how to spot a destructive change. - Treat a migration that silently loosens access as a top-severity bug. - Write strong TypeScript, and design tests for correctness, such as differential, property-based, or corpus testing across multiple Postgres versions. - Are comfortable with compiler-style problems: dependency graphs, topological ordering, cycle handling, and diffing. - Can confidently review complex changes in an intricate codebase, including AI-generated PRs. - Have owned software in production with users in the loop: staged rollouts, error monitoring, and triaging real bug reports. - Have led a technical project across several teams, from an ambiguous start to production. - Communicate clearly in writing and thrive in async, globally distributed teams. Nice to have, roughly in order of how much they’d help: - Have built or maintained schema diff or migration tooling (such as migra, pg-schema-diff, Atlas, pgroll, sqitch, Prisma Migrate, or Flyway/Liquibase), or worked with pg_dump internals. - Open-source maintainer experience: API contracts, semver, documentation, and community triage. - Familiarity with Postgres extensions such as pg_cron, pgmq, pg_partman, vault, pg_net, pgvector, or PostGIS. - Experience with Go. - Contributions to Postgres itself, or authorship of a Postgres extension. - Experience with Supabase or another managed Postgres platform. WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

Greenhouse experience is beneficial but not required.</li> <li>Proficiency with Google Workspace, scheduling tools,  and a willingness to learn and use additional tools.</li> <li>Ability to communicate clearly and professionally in writing and verbally with candidates and internal stakeholders at all levels, including executives.</li> <li>Demonstrated strength in organization, time management, and prioritization, with a consistent focus on meeting deadlines and maintaining attention to detail.</li> <li>Ability to build collaborative relationships with team members across time zones and functions while maintaining a high level of confidentiality.</li> <li>Interest in learning about talent acquisition and contributing to an inclusive hiring process that attracts a qualified, diverse, and motivated team.</li> <li>Alignment with GitLab's values and comfort working in an all remote, asynchronous environment, including flexibility in your working hours to support candidates and hiring teams across multiple time zones, with openness to transferable experience from related coordination or operations roles.</li> </ul> <p>#LI-CM1</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>The Candidate Experience team partners with Recruiters, hiring managers, and People Operations to run a smooth, consistent, and inclusive hiring process across GitLab's all-remote, global organization. You'll join a collaborative group that coordinates interview logistics, manages candidate flow in our applicant tracking system, and supports offer and onboarding handoffs so candidates and hiring teams have a clear, organized experience at every stage. The team works asynchronously across time zones, using GitLab and shared documentation to stay aligned while handling high-volume hiring. Our focus is on refining processes, maintaining accurate data, and acting as brand ambassadors for GitLab's values in every candidate interaction.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

title: Director, Enterprise Sales
description: Regional Director, Enterprise Sales This is your moment Sweden. Norway. Denmark. Finland. Four markets, one region, and a team of elite sellers who are already winning. Abnormal is one of the fastest growing cybersecurity companies in the world, and we are looking for a Regional Director to take the Nordics to its next level. Every CISO in the region is facing the same problem: attackers are using AI to get past defences built for a different era. Abnormal exists to change that. You will be the leader who gets into the deals, runs to the fire, and builds on a team that is already formidable. This is not a role for someone who manages a forecast from behind a screen. It is for a leader who would rather be in the room with a CISO than in a meeting about the meeting. Your mission Overachieve the Nordics new annual recurring revenue (NARR) quota by winning enterprise accounts (2,000+ mailboxes) from first conversation to signature, and by growing them long after. Along the way, you will: Take an elite team and make it even better, through coaching, inspiration and an unrelenting standard. Be hands on in the deals that matter, side by side with your Account Executives. Spend your time where the revenue is: with customers, prospects and partners. Build a channel in the region from the ground up, with your own hands. Make the whole region move together, leading marketing, SDR and channel through a matrix model. How you will lead Hands on, always. You love getting into the deals with your AEs. You shape the strategy, join the critical calls, open doors at CISO, CIO and CTO level, and help close complex, multi-stakeholder deals from $200K+ through to $1M+. Inspire the team. You lead with energy and example. You know what great looks like because you have done it, and you make the people around you want to do it too. Run to the fire. When a deal is wobbling, a customer needs you or a competitor shows up, you are the first one there. Thrive in velocity. We are low friction on process and high on pace. You enjoy agility, you make decisions quickly, and you are comfortable in a dynamic, Slack-based working culture where the best ideas move at the speed of a message. Be external first. You will spend more time out in the market than in internal meetings, because that is where the pipeline and the relationships are. What you will own A programmatic sales playbook. Run a disciplined, repeatable approach to selling, embedded in the 3-Whys and MEDDPICC. Inspect deals with rigour, forecast monthly and quarterly with credibility, and lead Quarterly Business Reviews that drive action. The team. Develop each Account Executive in the areas that matter most to their skills and NARR results. Recruit when the region needs it, and keep a bench of future talent warm so you are never caught short. The matrix. Hold responsibility across channel, marketing and SDR in the region, bringing them together behind one plan to generate pipeline and accelerate new business. The channel. Build strategic relationships with existing channel partners and open up new ones. This is a hands-on builder role, not a hand-off. The customer. Maintain strong relationships with key customers in the region, focused on value realisation, timely renewals, rapid expansion and referrals. The proof. Partner closely with Sales Engineering to deliver outstanding demonstrations and a repeatable proof-of-concept and technology validation programme. The voice of the market. Be the voice of the customer and prospect inside Abnormal, with Sales Engineering, the POV team, Product and Marketing, so the right things get prioritised and more revenue gets closed. What you bring You are a proven winner who holds yourself accountable to consistent over-achievement, and who is hungry to build on something already strong. 10+ years of enterprise sales experience, with a track record of exceeding quota selling security, networking and/or software. 3+ years leading a sales team focused on new business and new logos. A hunter's mentality: you have led teams that create new demand, win new customers and source their own pipeline. A record of closing complex enterprise deals with multiple buying influences, in new or emerging solution categories, including deals of $200K+ and $1M+. Credibility with executives. You build strong relationships with customers and partners at the most senior levels, and translate technical features into business value. Fluency in consultative, value-based methodologies such as MEDDPICC, Force Management or Challenger Sale. Experience building or growing a channel, and the instinct to get hands on with partners. Outstanding verbal, written and presentation skills. A bias for action, comfort with ambiguity and real enjoyment of a fast-paced, low-process environment. Why you will love it here We are building a generational company, and you would be building it with us. Abnormal is one of the fastest growing cybersecurity companies in the world, selling something customers genuinely need in a category that is still being defined. The momentum is real, the product is differentiated and the opportunity ahead is enormous. Here, builders are not spectators. You will inherit a team of elite sellers and be trusted to make them even better. You will work shoulder to shoulder with Sales Engineering, Product and Marketing, and your voice will shape what we build and how we win. You will have the freedom to move fast, the support to do it well, and a front-row seat to something special. If you want to lead from the front, build a region and put your name on some of the most important deals in Nordic enterprise security, as part of a company people will talk about for decades, we would love to meet you. #LI-RJ1 A note on AI in our process:Â Abnormal AI uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiting team prepare for candidate interviews. These tools analyze resume content and role requirements to suggest interview questions and areas for the interviewer to explore.They do not make hiring decisions or screen candidates automatically. Every decision about a candidacy is made by a person. Further, if your application is successful and Abnormal AI makes a conditional offer of employment, we will carry out pre-employment checks which must be successfully completed to progress to a final offer. All processes and pre-employment checks are in line with prevailing legislation and Abnormal AI's policies relevant to our security and privacy standards. Abnormal AI is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. description: About Norm Norm builds AI-native professional services firms and the technology that powers them. Our mission is to help expert professionals deliver better work at greater scale. Professional judgment and experience guide what we build, while advances in the technology expand what our firms can deliver. Our shared agentic platform connects that progress across teams and services. Founded in 2023, Norm brings together experts across engineering, research, product, design and professional practice. Our legal and compliance platform serves institutions representing more than $35 trillion in combined assets under management. Norm also powers Norm Law, LLP, an affiliated AI-native law firm whose attorneys advise leading institutions on complex corporate matters. AI Fluency: Norm prefers all team members to be fluent in AI. Successful candidates actively use AI in their day-to-day work to support thinking, creation, and problem-solving. They use it to improve the quality and speed of their work and to continuously refine how work gets done end-to-end. Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate and discuss their AI usage throughout the interview process, including concrete examples of tools, workflows, and outcomes. We look for practical, hands-on experience, not theoretical familiarity. This Role We are hiring a hands-on Tech Lead for Norm Compliance, the team that owns Norm's compliance platform for asset managers: the product behind marketing and content review at some of the largest financial institutions in the US. You are an IC-style engineer who can also set an engineering roadmap and lead a team; you will lead up to seven engineers, own every technical decision inside the platform, and ship code yourself at least half of the week. The platform has been shipping for years. You will ramp with the engineers who know it best, then set its direction. How You'll Work The team is fully remote in the US and reports to the General Manager of Norm Compliance. You set the platform's technical direction, from architecture and standards to a roadmap you shape with the product manager and the General Manager. The team owns the platform end to end, including the infrastructure it runs on. Day to day you work with a product manager who owns the backlog and our commitments to clients, and with a client engagement/deployment strategy team that owns the relationships: you decide how the work gets done and how long it takes, they decide what we take on and when, and nothing reaches a client without both. Set the engineering roadmap for the platform with the product manager and the General Manager. Hire, onboard and grow a team of Staff and Senior engineers. Run on-call escalation. Answer clients' technical questions, in writing or through meetings, along the client engagement/deployment strategy team. Learn the platform with the engineers who run it today, ship with their review, then own it. title: Software Engineer, Collections Infra
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: As a Software Engineer on Collections Infra, you’ll help scale the infrastructure behind Notion’s database block. Databases power views, boards, charts, forms, and the workflows customers use to run their companies; as Notion grows into larger enterprise deployments and AI-native work, those systems need to become faster, more reliable, and ready for much higher concurrency. This team sits between infrastructure and product, building backend architecture that improves the customer experience while becoming a platform other Notion teams can build on. You’ll work on problems like database load performance, microservices, high-volume writes from agents, and the flexibility that makes Notion databases powerful and hard to scale. This role can be based in either San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - By your 90th day, you’ll understand how Collections Infra supports Notion’s database block, ship improvements to database performance or reliability, and build context on the scale challenges behind larger enterprise workspaces and AI-driven write volume. - You’ll use AI as a real engineering collaborator: to learn unfamiliar systems faster, explore debugging paths, generate tests, summarize traces or logs, and pressure-test implementation plans before shipping. - You’ll contribute to the team’s work to make databases faster and more reliable at P95 scale, especially as customers build larger centralized databases with more concurrent usage. - By the end of your first year, you’ll have helped raise the quality bar for Collections infrastructure through better architecture, observability, documentation, or system boundaries that make future work easier to build on. - You’ll partner with senior engineers and product-facing teams to evolve Collections as a platform, balancing internal developer needs with the external customer experience of databases. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - Strong backend engineering fundamentals, with interest in performance, reliability, scalability, and systems that need to hold up under real customer load. - Curiosity about distributed systems, microservices, and data-layer trade-offs; experience in these areas is helpful, but we care most about your ability to learn quickly and reason from first principles. - Practical comfort with JavaScript or TypeScript, or the ability to ramp quickly in a codebase where those tools matter. - Grit and truth-seeking in technical problem solving: you can iterate when the first approach does not move P50/P95 performance, and you’re motivated by finding the real bottleneck. - A self-guided learning style: you use docs, code, teammates, and AI to build context, ask better questions, and turn ambiguity into steady progress. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $150,000 - $168,000 per year. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content Deep local cultural awareness and familiarity with regional news, current events, and contemporary culture title: Storage Platform Engineer
description: ABOUT THE ROLE Supabase runs millions of Postgres databases, and storage performance is now one of the biggest levers on how fast, reliable, and affordable they are. We're building a software-defined, NVMe-over-Fabrics storage platform underneath Supabase Postgres. Postgres stays unmodified, and the new layer delivers near-local-NVMe performance with the durability and flexibility of networked storage. As the senior engineer driving storage, you'll own this effort end to end: the architecture and build-vs-buy decisions, integration into our compute platform, and operating the system in production. Your first goal is raw Postgres I/O performance at scale. In the longer term, the layer you build will provide the block-level snapshots and copy-on-write clones behind database branching, fast restores, and instant resizes. Because it's software-defined, it will also travel with us as we expand beyond a single cloud provider into multi-cloud and colocated infrastructure. This is a foundational, high-ownership role. You'll set the technical direction for storage at Supabase and help grow the team around it. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR - Lead the architecture of Supabase's NVMe-oF storage platform, including evaluating and deciding between adopting existing software-defined storage and building on SPDK - Integrate networked block storage into our Kubernetes-based compute platform through CSI drivers and custom controllers, covering provisioning, attach/detach, resizing, and migration - Make Postgres fast on networked storage by profiling and tuning the full I/O path, from fsync, WAL, and checkpoints through the kernel block layer, NVMe/TCP, and the network - Design for durability and availability, including replication or erasure coding, failure domains, failover, and data-integrity verification - Build I/O isolation and QoS so that noisy neighbors can't degrade other tenants - Set performance and reliability SLOs, and build the benchmarking and observability to hold the system to them - Design the layer for block-level snapshots and copy-on-write clones, laying the groundwork for database branching - month-end processes, including derivatives and hedge accounting. </li> <li>Maintaining existing and developing new treasury related internal controls that protect our financial data and our balance sheet substantiation process, working with 2LoD and 3LoD along the way.</li> <li>Supporting our year end processes, preparing Treasury related disclosures, dealing with external audit queries and ad hoc assistance on non-Treasury related aspects of the cycle. </li> <li>Understanding the Treasury business and their products to write insightful management commentary on results.</li> <li>Reviewing new Treasury products, assessing and determining the accounting treatment before implementing the GL configuration mapping in our TMS.</li> <li>Working with our engineers and data teams to automate the production elements of this role, allowing you to focus on the parts of the role where your knowledge and skills provide the most value.</li> <li>Learning SQL skills to run reports and propose solutions that make our processes efficient and scalable.</li> <li>Ad hoc support on non-Treasury related initiatives.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if you..</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li>You’re a qualified accountant and have knowledge and/or understanding of Treasury products in a banking context.</li> <li>You have a great eye for derivatives in our annual report.</li> <li>You’re comfortable translating complex information into simple words for people with diverse backgrounds.</li> <li>You’re interested in using data (SQL skills would be a bonus).</li> <li>You thrive in a dynamic and constantly evolving environment.</li> <li>What we’re doing at Monzo excites you!</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>💰 </strong>£56,100 - £75,900 (depending on experience) + Incentive Award tied to your performance. </li> <li><strong>📍</strong>This role can be based in our London or Cardiff offices. Read our full list of<a href="https://monzo.com/careers"> benefits.</a></p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Recruiter Screening Call. </li> <li>30 Minute Initial Interview with the Hiring Manager. </li> <li>45 Minute Role Specific Interview.</li> <li>45 Minute Behavioural Interview.</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3 - 4 weeks, your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible!</p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo 🤖 You can read them <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">here</a>.</p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h3>An overview of this role</h3> <p>As an <span class="textBold">Engineering Manager</span>, you’ll guide GitLab’s dedicated <span class="textBold">Software Supply Chain Security (SSCS) Add-On</span> engineering team as it develops core capabilities including <span class="textBold">Dependency Firewall, Build Provenance, Malicious Packages detection, and Artifact Signing</span>. This is a founding management role where you’ll help shape how the team works, partner closely with the Staff Backend Engineer, Product Manager, and SSCS stage management, and turn a defined roadmap into steady, high-quality delivery for enterprise customers with strict security and compliance needs. You’ll focus on developing the team, creating a healthy operating rhythm, and establishing predictable execution for the SSCS SKU.</p> <p>You’ll join a product area where customers in regulated industries are already validating the need, and your work will help GitLab deliver software supply chain security features that customers can rely on. While technical credibility matters, your main focus will be growing a strong backend engineering team, enabling team members in their development, and creating the conditions for long-term delivery and quality.</p> <h3>What you’ll do</h3> <ul> <li value="1"><span class="textBold">Guide</span> a backend engineering team building the SSCS Add-On across dependency enforcement, build provenance, malicious package detection, and artifact signing.</li> <li value="2"><span class="textBold">Be responsible for</span> <span class="textBold">Drive</span> engineering delivery for general availability milestones by aligning sequencing, scope, and dependencies with the Staff Backend Engineer and Product Manager.</li> <li value="3"><span class="textBold">Develop</span> the team by partnering with Talent Acquisition on sourcing, interview design, candidate evaluation, and hiring decisions.</li> <li value="4"><span class="textBold">Run</span> regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and career development conversations that enable growth and clear expectations.</li> <li value="5"><span class="textBold">Advance</span> engineering quality by monitoring cycle time, defect rates, and test coverage, and by addressing risks early.</li> <li value="6"><span class="textBold">Coordinate</span> quarterly planning and roadmap tradeoff discussions with SSCS stage leadership and Product.</li> <li value="7"><span class="textBold">Work with</span> Finance and other partners on headcount pacing and team planning as the Add-On scales.</li> <li value="8"><span class="textBold">Represent</span> the SSCS Add-On team within stage leadership discussions and help ensure strong communication across functions.</li> <li value="8">Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.</li> </ul> <h3>What you’ll bring</h3> <ul> <li value="1"><span class="textBold">Over 3 years of experience guiding</span> backend product engineering teams in security, DevOps, or platform engineering environments.</li> <li value="2"><span class="textBold">Ability to hire and grow</span> backend or security engineers in distributed team environments, with practical understanding of the talent landscape for these roles.</li> <li value="3"><span class="textBold">Technical credibility</span> to contribute to architecture discussions involving package registries, CI/CD pipeline security, and signing infrastructure.</li> <li value="4"><span class="textBold">Experience managing</span> predictable delivery across multi-quarter product roadmaps and managing cross-team dependencies.</li> <li value="5"><span class="textBold">Comfort working</span> in an asynchronous, documentation-driven organization with clear written communication.</li> <li value="6"><span class="textBold">Familiarity with</span> supply chain security, artifact management, or compliance-focused product areas, or transferable experience from related domains.</li> <li value="7"><span class="textBold">Working knowledge of</span> concepts related to frameworks and ecosystems such as SLSA and Sigstore.</li> <li value="8"><span class="textBold">Ability to build credibility</span> with engineers, product partners, and customer-facing stakeholders through clear judgment, coaching, and teamwork.</li> </ul> <h3>About the team</h3> <p>The <span class="textBold">SSCS Add-On team</span> is a product engineering team within GitLab’s <span class="textBold">Software Supply Chain Security</span> stage. We work on key capabilities in the SSCS Add-On SKU and collaborate closely with product and engineering partners to deliver security features for customers operating in regulated environments. You’ll report to the SSCS Senior Engineering Manager and partner directly with the Staff Backend Engineer and Product Manager. As a distributed team working asynchronously across regions, we are focused on strong delivery practices, team health, and scaling the product area with clarity and accountability. For more on how related teams work, see <a class="textLink" href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/development/sec/software-supply-chain-security/pipeline-security/" target="_blank">Team Handbook Page</a>.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement.
