title: Mobile Developer
description: At Luscii, we develop several applications within the OMRON Digital Health Circle, including the Luscii Thuismeten app and OMRON Connect. Together, we build technology that makes healthcare more accessible, giving patients and healthcare professionals more space to focus on care. As a Mobile Developer , you will contribute to this mission by developing and improving the applications that connect people, devices and healthcare. Our digital health solutions enable healthcare professionals to monitor patients remotely, helping people receive the right care in the right place. You will work across our mobile applications, creating reliable, intuitive and high-performing experiences for patients and healthcare professionals alike. Beyond developing and improving our apps, you will help shape our technical direction, explore new technologies and share your expertise with colleagues. You will have the autonomy to take ownership, make technical decisions and contribute beyond your immediate responsibilities, supported by Luscii's Holacratic way of working. Your role As a Mobile Developer at Luscii, you will take ownership of the development, optimisation and maintenance of our mobile applications across iOS and Android. You bring ideas to life, make well-considered technical decisions and help ensure our applications remain performant, stable, scalable and easy to maintain. You will work closely with colleagues across development, QA and support, combining hands-on engineering with technical ownership. Whether you are building a new feature, exploring a technology through a proof of concept or resolving a production issue, you will help us continuously improve the quality and usability of our digital health solutions. What you will be doing: Develop, maintain and optimise mobile applications using native technologies such as Kotlin and Swift, with a focus on performance, stability and user experience. Contribute to mobile architecture, technical design and modular codebases, applying clean architecture, object-oriented design principles and patterns such as MVVM and MVI. Build intuitive user interfaces using technologies such as Jetpack Compose and SwiftUI, following platform-specific design guidelines. Develop and maintain features that communicate with Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices, as well as web services, cloud platforms and APIs. Build prototypes and proof of concepts to explore new technologies, validate technical approaches and identify opportunities for improvement. Investigate and resolve production issues through debugging and performance analysis, covering areas such as memory management, multithreading and networking. Contribute to code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD processes, sharing technical knowledge and helping colleagues make sound implementation decisions. Why Luscii? Read more about working at Luscii and how we work at Luscii/OMRON. Together, we are working on a mission to create space for care. Freedom, autonomy and ownership are of great importance in this. You are responsible for your own results and work according to the principles of Holacracy. Most important benefits Salary : € 4.600 - € 5.900 gross per month (based on 32 hours per week – that’s full-time at Luscii). Remote-first : Work from anywhere in The Netherlands. We stay connected through monthly in-person team days called Assemblii . Flexible setup : Create your own ideal workspace. Whatever works best for you - we’ve got you covered here. The ideal candidate… … probably doesn't exist, but if you can tick most of the checkboxes below, please apply! We are looking for somebody who is comfortable in taking ownership and making well-considered decisions independently. You enjoy the autonomy to shape your work and responsibilities, while actively seeking collaboration and alignment with others. You know when to step up, when to involve colleagues and when to move forward decisively. Working independently does not mean working in isolation for you. You feel at ease being both a self-starter and a committed team player, contributing to shared goals while taking responsibility for your own domain. You value open communication, transparency, and mutual trust. You have at least five years of experience in mobile development, with a strong background in native Android and/or iOS development. You have extensive experience with Kotlin and/or Swift. You have a relevant bachelor's degree, for example in Computer Science or Computer Engineering and you are familiar with working in an Agile environment. You have a solid understanding of mobile architecture and software design principles, including clean architecture, object-oriented design, MVVM and/or MVI. You know how to build and maintain modular applications. You have experience with mobile development frameworks and tools such as Jetpack Compose, SwiftUI, Kotlin Coroutines, Flow and Kotlin Multiplatform. You are also familiar with unit testing and/or UI testing, CI/CD pipelines and platform-specific design guidelines. You understand what it takes to build reliable, high-performing mobile applications, including memory management, multithreading, networking, debugging and optimisation. You have experience integrating web services, cloud technologies, APIs and Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices. You are open to working in a Holacratic organization and curious about our way of organizing work, roles, and responsibilities; English is our primary language for all internal communication at Luscii, so you're fluent in that language. Interested? Apply now! Would you like more information? Feel free to contact our recruiter Björn Bogerd via What does the recruitment process look like? We organise three interviews for each vacancy. It is an extensive process, but we want to ensure that there is a good fit in regards to a potential collaboration, our culture and our way of working. All interviews are conducted online and the entire procedure is planned in advance to keep momentum. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Software Engineer AI Coding Tasks
description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$400-US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$400-US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Requirements 2+ years of professional software engineering Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code) Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++ Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing Regular use of an AI coding tool Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words At least 10 hours a week, starting now A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines) Nice to have Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure Experience building agent tasks or RL environments Terms Between US$400 - US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer Please mention the word **FANS** and tag RNDguMjE3LjIyOC4yMDk= when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RNDguMjE3LjIyOC4yMDk=). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.

Vet requests, resolve conflicts, recommend tradeoffs, and protect time for focused work and breaks in line with GitLab’s meeting practices.</li> <li>Maintain regular communication with each leader and track updates from direct reports, peers, and cross-functional partners. Flag dependencies, upcoming deliverables, and items that need review, decisions, or escalation before they slip.</li> <li>Plan and execute all-hands, ask-me-anything sessions, organizational summits, leadership offsites, and team-level engineering events, including hands-on support for our annual R&D summit (1,000+ attendees). Coordinate logistics, agendas, speakers, content, and post-event follow-up with partner executive business administrators across Engineering, Product, Sales, and Customer Success.</li> <li>Support hiring for senior technical roles by coordinating interview loops, debriefs, executive closing calls, and candidate communication across time zones. Commercially Savvy Problem Solving: You love building authentic relationships, but you never lose sight of the commercial target. objectives.</li> <li value="9">Identify and recommend training and services opportunities that support customer enablement and long-term success.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li to act as a trusted advisor to technical and business stakeholders, partnering with customers to define, prioritize, and achieve their desired outcomes.</li> <li value="4">Strong communication skills, The work is highly cross-functional: your partners span go-to-market, Finance, People, R&D, Data & Insights and more, often with competing priorities.</p> <p>This is a leadership role, not a hands-on coding role. You’ll own the technical direction and the team’s standards and working practices, and spend most of your time developing engineers and making sure the team delivers at pace while holding a very high bar for quality. Hiring will be a big focus early on as the team grows.</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Lead and develop the team.</strong> Coach and grow engineers across time zones, with clear expectations, useful feedback and async practices that hold up, and hire well as the team grows.</li> <li><strong>Own the technical direction and quality bar.</strong> This is an AI-native team: agents write most of the code, and engineers set the direction and own the result. Decide together whether a problem needs an app, an agent or a skill.</li> <li><strong>Protect sensitive data.</strong> Several applications hold people and financial data. Work with Security, Privacy and Legal on access, data protection reviews and works council requirements.</li> <li><strong>Own each application for its whole life.</strong> Make sure each one has an owner, monitoring, support and a known cost to run, and consolidate or retire it when it stops earning its keep.</li> <li><strong>Measure what matters.</strong> Track idea-to-production time, user satisfaction (CSAT) and cost to run against value.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li>Several years managing software engineering teams, including senior engineers, with a record of hiring and developing people.</li> <li>A background building and running production software across the stack, including data and integrations, so you can engage credibly with the technical detail.</li> <li>Sound engineering and product judgment: you know when an approach needs to change and where custom software is justified.</li> <li>Experience leading a distributed team across time zones in a highly cross-functional, remote and asynchronous setting.</li> <li>Experience leading AI-native development, where agents write most of the code, and the judgment to keep quality high as output grows.</li> <li>Strong communication with technical and non-technical partners.</li> </ul> <h2>Preferred qualifications</h2> <ul> <li>Experience leading a portfolio of internal business applications.</li> <li>Experience with GitLab, CI/CD and data platforms such as Snowflake.</li> <li>Experience with applications that handle sensitive people or financial data.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>Enterprise Application Development sits within Enterprise AI in GitLab’s Enterprise Technology & AI organization. Check outputs for accuracy and context rather than relying on automated summaries alone.</li> <li>Identify recurring friction in how the teams work, and propose and implement improvements to processes and documentation.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience supporting two or more VP-level leaders simultaneously at a fast-growing company, ideally SaaS or AI-forward, adapting to distinct working styles and business priorities.</li> <li>A bias for action and ownership: you move from ask to done quickly, act independently within agreed priorities, and resources.</li> <li>Experience managing complex calendars across time zones, using judgment to balance competing requests and checking scheduling details and attendees.</li> <li>Project management record of building trust with executives, peers, and other executive support partners.</li> <li>Sound judgment and discretion with confidential information.</li> <li>Experience in a remote, travel for team meetings and all-hands (about four trips a year, three to four days each).</li> <li>Located in the US or Canada, with strong overlap with Pacific time.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>You’ll join GitLab’s Marketing organization and support two leaders who together lead about 120 people in a fast-moving, AI-forward organization. You'll own the technical evaluation and validation stages of the sales cycle, guide customers through proofs of concept and value, and translate platform capabilities into outcomes that agency leaders, CIOs, CISOs, and procurement officers can defend in a budget request or an RFP evaluation.</p> <p>You'll partner closely with SLED account executives, channel partners, and systems integrators, provide technical guidance from first conversation through successful deployment, and bring the voice of the SLED customer back into Product, Sales, and Marketing.</p> <p><strong>Location and travel:</strong> The territory covers all states east of the Mississippi River. The candidate must reside in the Northeast part of the United States. This role requires up to 50% travel.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Engage SLED customers onsite and remotely, from state capitals to university campuses, with tailored demos, technical presentations, and hands-on workshops that tie GitLab to their mission.</li> <li>Partner with SLED account executives to shape account strategies that align with each customer's fiscal year budget cycle, legislative appropriations, IT modernization plans, and grant or federal pass through funding.</li> <li>Own the technical evaluation process, including proof of concept (POC) and proof of value (POV) design and delivery, and provide technical responses for RFIs, RFPs, RFQs, and security questionnaires.</li> <li>Support purchases made through cooperative purchasing agreements and statewide contract vehicles by working with channel and reseller partners.</li> <li>Guide customers through state and sector security requirements, such as GovRAMP and NIST frameworks, and show how build data driven business cases that quantify delivery bottlenecks, giving customers a defensible basis for budget requests and clear evidence of return on taxpayer investment.</li> <li>Build relationships with CIOs, CISOs, agency directors, enterprise architects, faculty, research computing leaders, and procurement officers so they become advocates for GitLab, including across agencies campuses.</li> <li>Serve as the SLED customer advocate internally, channeling feedback on procurement, compliance, and deployment needs to Product, Sales, and Marketing.</li> <li>Stay current on GitLab and related technologies, and create reusable SLED demos, reference architectures, and assets for customers and partners.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> role of resellers and systems integrators.</li> <li>Hands-on experience using GitLab and familiarity with modern software development and operations practices, such as CI/CD, DevSecOps, and automation.</li> <li>Experience with cloud, hybrid, and self-managed deployments in regulated environments, including government cloud regions, and an understanding of data residency and sovereignty concerns.</li> <li>Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks common in SLED, such as GovRAMP and NIST SP 800-53.</li> <li>Ability to connect technical solutions to mission outcomes, such as resident service delivery, cyber resilience, cost avoidance, and workforce efficiency, and to advise senior stakeholders on tradeoffs and options.</li> <li>Strong communication and relationship-building skills, including presenting to both technical teams and non-technical leaders such as agency heads, procurement officers, and university administrators.</li> <li>Openness to learning, seeking feedback, and building new skills, including familiarity with GitLab's Solutions Architect handbook and related resources.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Prior experience working in or for state or local government IT, or a university IT or research computing organization.</li> <li>Experience with legacy or mainframe modernization programs.</li> <li>Familiarity with AI governance practices in the public sector, such as AI use-case inventories, acceptable-use policies, and risk assessments.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> By solving customers' problems, treating them fairly and being transparent, we believe we can make banking better 💪</p> <p>Our Complaints team works alongside Customer Operations to make sure customers receive the best possible service, even when things go wrong. We put empathy at the heart of how we handle complaints and use what we learn to make things better.</p> <p>As our Complaints Policy Manager, you'll lead a team of technical experts and shape how we handle complaints across Monzo. You'll bring together regulatory requirements, customer needs and operational priorities to make sure our policies are clear, effective and fair. You'll play an important role in strengthening our complaints framework, influencing decisions across the business and helping us deliver better customer outcomes at scale.</p> <p><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by…</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Leading, coaching and developing a team of Complaints Lead Experts, creating an environment where people can grow and deliver high-quality technical advice.</p> </li> <li> <p>Owning and improving our complaints policy framework, making sure processes, guidance, systems and customer communications are consistent, effective and meet regulatory expectations.</p> </li> <li> <p>Providing oversight and direction on complex complaint handling issues, supporting teams to make fair, well-informed decisions across different complaint types.</p> </li> <li> <p>Using insights from quality assurance, Financial Ombudsman Service (FOS) outcomes and escalations to identify root causes, shape our strategy and drive meaningful improvements.</p> </li> <li> <p>Partnering with Product, Legal, Risk, Compliance and Operations leaders to develop and embed policies, frameworks and operational changes that improve customer experiences.</p> </li> <li> <p>Leading our response to regulatory developments, audits and compliance reviews, making sure our controls, reporting and governance remain robust.</p> </li> <li> <p>Overseeing specialist activities, including regulatory disclosures, legal escalations and engagement with third parties, to make sure we meet our obligations and deliver fair customer outcomes.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>You have strong knowledge of UK complaint-handling regulations, including the FCA's DISP handbook and FOS requirements, and can apply them to real customer situations.</p> </li> <li> <p>You're experienced in leading, coaching and developing technical specialists, helping them build confidence and deliver great outcomes.</p> </li> <li> <p>You can see the bigger picture, using complaint data, quality insights and emerging trends to shape strategy and improve how things work.</p> </li> <li> <p>You're comfortable managing regulatory governance, control frameworks, audits and changes to regulatory requirements.</p> </li> <li> <p>You can build strong relationships across different teams, influence senior stakeholders and turn complex regulatory information into clear, practical guidance.</p> </li> <li> <p>You're confident balancing long-term strategic priorities with day-to-day operational challenges, making thoughtful decisions and keeping things moving.</p> </li> <li> <p>You're passionate about fair customer outcomes and finding ways to make complaint handling simpler, more consistent and more empathetic.</p> </li> </ul> <p><em>Not ticking every box? Read our full list of <a href="https://monzo.com/careers">benefits</a>.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <p>1. Application <br>2. This allows us to more expediently and efficiently predict, identify, disambiguate, and route customer problems at scale to support a rapidly expanding company with global ambitions across multiple geographies.</p> <p>You’ll be working closely with a team of Machine Learning Scientists in Operations, embedded in product squads alongside data scientists, backend, mobile and web engineers, product managers, user researchers, designers, and operations specialists.</p> <h1>Your day-to-day:</h1> <p>As a technical individual contributor, you’ll be providing technical leadership and shipping highly impactful ML-based solutions. You’ll be embedded in a cross-functional product squad, working closely with product managers, data scientists, backend engineers, and designers in an agile environment. You’ll also be a technical leader within the wider Machine Learning discipline, helping to steer technical work and drive up standards.</p> <p>This will involve:</p> <ul> <li> <p>Working with stakeholders across the organisation to identify and scope out the most impactful opportunities to transform Customer Operations with Machine Learning.</p> </li> <li> <p>Leading the design and development of advanced Machine Learning models, exploring how LLMs, RAG, and sequence-based architectures can drive improvements in query resolution and routing.</p> </li> <li> <p>Providing technical leadership to drive up levels of technical expertise and best practice across the Machine Learning discipline, leading by example and mentoring others.</p> </li> <li> <p>Steering ongoing technical strategy, working closely with our MLOps team and backend engineers to enable rapid iteration of models and optimisations of the full ML model lifecycle.</p> </li> </ul> <h1>You should apply if:</h1> <p>What we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!</p> <ul> <li> <p>You have a multiple year track record of excellence leading the development and deployment of advanced Machine Learning models to tackle real business problems preferably in a fast moving tech company</p> </li> <li> <p>You have experience developing and shipping deep learning, graph-based, and/or sequence-based ML architectures to production and delivering business impact</p> </li> <li> <p>You're impact driven and excited to own the end to end journey that starts with a business problem and ends with your solution having a measurable impact in production</p> </li> <li> <p>You have a self-starter mindset; you proactively identify issues and opportunities and tackle them without being told to do so</p> </li> <li> <p>You have extensive experience writing production Python code and a strong command of SQL. You are comfortable using them every day, and keen to learn <a href="https://go.dev/">Go lang</a> which is used in many of our backend microservices</p> </li> <li> <p>you’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity and have experience helping your team and stakeholders resolve that ambiguity</p> </li> <li> <p>you want to be involved in building a product that you (and the people you know) use every day</p> </li> <li> <p>you have a product mindset: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions</p> </li> <li> <p>You're excited about fast-moving developments in Machine Learning and can communicate those ideas to colleagues who are not familiar with the domain</p> </li> <li> <p>You’re adaptable, curious and enjoy learning new technologies and ideas</p> </li> </ul> <h1>Nice to haves:</h1> <ul> <li> <p>Experience working with customer operations, capacity planning, forecasting, or in regulated institutions.</p> </li> <li> <p>Commercial experience writing critical production code and working with microservices.</p> </li> </ul> <h1>The interview process:</h1> <p>Our interview process involves 3 main stages. We promise not to ask you any brain teasers or trick questions!</p> <p>30 minute recruiter call</p> <p>45 minute call with hiring manager</p> <p>Full Loop: ML Modelling Interview, Product & ML interview, Behavioural Interview, Leadership interview</p> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You will have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process but if you do have any specific questions ahead of this please contact us on <a href="mailto:tech-hiring@monzo.com">tech-hiring@monzo.com</a>. Please also use that email to let us know if there's anything we can do to make your application process easier for you, because of disability, neurodiversity or any other personal reason.</p> <h1>What’s in it for you:</h1> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">here</a></p> <p>If you prefer to work part-time, we'll make this happen whenever we can - whether this is to help you meet other commitments or strike a great work-life balance</p> <p>#LI-REMOTE #LI-SR1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. leader and hands-on individual contributor, spearheading our ML and GenAI capabilities and shipping key models that powers magical Business Banking experiences.</p> <p>You’ll:</p> <ul> <li>Be one of title: Senior Field Marketer
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: Notion’s Field Marketing team owns the in-person moments that move our target sales assisted accounts forward. We design world class hosted events, executive experiences, and third-party activations that open new relationships, deepen the ones we have, and turn interest into pipeline. As a Senior Field Marketing Manager, you will own the strategy and execute tier 1 field events that drive pipeline and contribute meaningfully to Notion’s business. This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Own end-to-end planning, execution, and measurement of field programs to support our AMER Sales team - encompassing executive experiences, large-format educational events, trade shows, and co-sponsored activations with partners. - Drive pipeline goals in partnership with Sales by building field programs that create new opportunities and help advance existing ones. Track and report on pipeline contribution and program ROI. - Build out strategies, shape our calendar, and work closely with sales to build out a calendar that touches the evolving sales needs. - Manage all event logistics, production, venue sourcing, budget tracking, marketing campaigns, sales enablement, content development, and audience acquisition. - Use data to guide field investments, combining quantitative results and qualitative feedback to evaluate what’s working. Measure both pipeline impact and top-of-funnel awareness, including reach and engagement with target audiences, and use those insights to improve future programs. - Partner closely with Sales and broader Marketing team to align events and audiences to objectives for top accounts and craft tailored programs that nurture those accounts SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - 8+ years of related marketing experience. - You’re a leader. You take ownership, bring people together around a clear plan, and keep programs moving from idea through execution. You’re comfortable making decisions, navigating ambiguity, and building trust with partners along the way. - You love both strategy and execution. You can turn Sales priorities into a thoughtful field plan and roll up your sleeves to bring each event to life. - You're pipeline-obsessed. You understand how your programs connect to revenue and can speak credibly about pipeline contribution, not just top-of-funnel metrics. - You're a strong cross-functional collaborator. You know how to work with sales, ops, and creative teams — and you can align people around a shared goal without needing authority to do it. - You have a bias for action and experimentation. You'd rather test and learn than wait for consensus, and you know how to balance scrappiness with strategic thinking. - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results. - You're a creative problem-solver who doesn't wait for a perfect playbook. You've built field events from scratch, and you're energized by figuring out what works in new territory. NICE TO HAVES: - Experience in a fast-paced, B2B tech environment - You're a Notion user and understand our value to businesses - Salesforce, Marketo experience We hire talented and passionate people from a variety of backgrounds because we want our global employee base to represent the wide diversity of our customers. If you’re excited about a role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every bullet point listed in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. If you’re a builder at heart, share our company values, and enthusiastic about making software toolmaking ubiquitous, we want to hear from you. Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $175,000-$200,000 per year. By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528. #LI-Onsite A NOTE ON AI You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know. Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

title: Solutions Architect - Federal
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p>Solutions Architect - Public Sector</p> <p><strong>The role</strong></p> <p>A trusted advisor to U.S. government customers, helping them understand how GitLab’s DevSecOps platform addresses business and mission outcomes. Owns the technical evaluation and validation stages of the sales cycle and provides technical guidance from first conversation through successful deployment.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <p>- Engage government customers, onsite and remotely, with tailored demos, technical presentations and hands-on workshops throughout the pre-sales process.</p> <p>- Manage the technical aspects of the sales cycle, including high quality presentations, custom demos, proofs of concept, technical deep-dive sessions and workshops, RFI and RFP responses, and differentiating GitLab from alternatives.</p> <p>- Be the directly responsible individual (DRI) for technical evaluations and success plans, including POC/POV ownership, tender and audit support and technical input into proposals, capturing success criteria and handoff details for a smooth path to deployment and adoption.</p> <p>- Partner with the sales team to shape and execute account strategies that drive GitLab adoption within government environments.</p> <p>- Build deep relationships with technical and business stakeholders so they become advocates for GitLab within their organizations.</p> <p>- Run Value Stream Assessments to identify opportunities for customers to improve their software delivery, with support from a Senior SA.</p> <p>- Take part in conferences and trade shows, and contribute to case studies, white papers and media articles for government customers and partners.</p> <p>- Deliver world-class customer service during pre-sales, implementation and post-sales activities.</p> <p>- Channel customer feedback internally to influence roadmap and messaging, and keep building your expertise in GitLab and related technologies.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></p> <p>- Consumption experience: Independently owning a straightforward consumption-led technical motion with the AE in government environments, from usage-led discovery and technical POV through an adoption hypothesis and clear next steps toward production.</p> <p>- Technical experience: Hands-on experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines and containers, and working knowledge of on-premises, self-managed and restricted-network environments alongside cloud, including installation, configuration, upgrades and integration with existing enterprise tooling.</p> <p>- Experience supporting federal customers through technical evaluations, solution design and the path to authorization.</p> <p>- Experience with technical pre-sales, or as a professional in the field of information technology.</p> <p>- Experience with cloud computing platforms and related technologies in regulated or security conscious environments.Familiarity with federal security and compliance frameworks, such as FedRAMP, DoD Impact Levels, NIST 800-53 and the Risk Management Framework, DISA STIGs and FIPS 140, and how they shape deployment and tooling decisions.</p> <p>- The ability to connect technical solutions to measurable business or mission outcomes and to advise senior stakeholders on trade-offs and options.</p> <p>- Strong, confident communication and relationship building skills, including leading customer meetings, demos and value-focused conversations.</p> <p>- TS/SCI security clearance is a plus,  but not a requirement.</p> <p>- Location in the Washington, DC metro area.</p> <p>- Openness to learning, seeking feedback and building new skills.</p> <p>- Ability to travel at least 25%.</p> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>The Public Sector Solutions Architecture team sits within GitLab Sales and works with U.S. federal and other government customers and partners to show how GitLab’s DevSecOps platform supports mission outcomes in regulated, security conscious environments.</p> <p>We work alongside the Public Sector sales team through every stage of the cycle, from first conversation and RFI or RFP responses to deployment and adoption.</p> <p>GitLab sells in a consumption-based model, so our work does not end at the proof of value. We stay close after the technical win to help agencies move from evaluation to production use and growth.</p> <p>We share what we learn, coach each other, and care about measurable mission outcomes.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our <a class="waffle-rich-text-link" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/" data-sheets-formula-bar-text-link="https://bit.ly/GLBeneUS" data-sheets-formula-bar-text-style="font-size:12px;color:#1155cc;font-weight:normal;text-decoration:underline;font-family:''Arial'';font-style:normal;text-decoration-skip-ink:none;">benefits</a><span data-sheets-formula-bar-text-style="font-size:12px;color:#000000;font-weight:normal;text-decoration:none;font-family:'Arial';font-style:normal;text-decoration-skip-ink:none;"> and </span><a class="waffle-rich-text-link" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/stock-options/" data-sheets-formula-bar-text-link="https://bit.ly/GLequity" data-sheets-formula-bar-text-style="font-size:12px;color:#1155cc;font-weight:normal;text-decoration:underline;font-family:''Arial'';font-style:normal;text-decoration-skip-ink:none;">equity</a>. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.</em></p></div><div class="title">United States Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$113,400</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$191,700 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. title: Senior Data Architect (remote from Europe)
description: Data Architecture & Governance Designs scalable and reusable data architectures to support transversal use across multiple domains and systems. Leads the definition and standardization of enterprise-wide common data models (submissions, cases, products, etc.). Develops and enforces data governance policies to support consistent, high-quality, and compliant data usage. Defines and implements data classification standards and integrates them into data cataloguing solutions. Supports the implementation and enforcement of data retention and lifecycle policies in alignment with regulatory and business needs. API Design & Integration Defines API contracts and facilitates alignment between producers and consumers of data services. Ensures APIs reflect well-defined and reusable data models, enabling efficient integration across teams and systems. Leads integration efforts with enterprise data platforms, ensuring data flows are secure, traceable, and optimised. Testing, Documentation & Support Designs test data strategies for validating data pipelines and ensuring robustness of data-dependent applications. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>About the role</h2> <p>As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will design, implement, and evolve product capabilities while solving high-scope backend problems and influencing the technical and product direction of our teams. You will move beyond "assigned work" to actively improve the quality, reliability, and performance of our systems. You will work across product, frontend, infrastructure, data, and security boundaries, making sound architectural trade-offs, communicating complex ideas clearly in an asynchronous environment, and helping define the standards for a high-scale, global product.</p> <h2>Why you’ll love this role</h2> <ul> <li><strong>High Impact: </strong>You aren't just shipping features; you are shaping the architecture of a global platform used by millions.</li> <li><strong>Technical Agency: </strong>You will influence team objectives, technical direction, and long-range goals, helping us solve problems of high scope and complexity.</li> <li><strong>Innovative Culture: </strong>You will get to experiment with and integrate agentic AI into production engineering workflows, moving beyond simple prompt engineering to build resilient, AI-assisted systems.</li> <li><strong>Autonomy: </strong>You will thrive in our remote-first, asynchronous organization, where clear written communication and self-direction are the pillars of success.</li> <li><strong>User-Centric Collaboration: </strong>You’ll partner closely with PMs and designers to shape requirements, ensuring every technical decision delivers genuine value to our users.</li> </ul> <div class="c-message_actions__container c-message__actions"> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Drive Technical Direction: </strong>Design and ship moderate to complex backend features with minimal guidance, making pragmatic choices between modular-monolith code, shared components, or independently operated services.</li> <li><strong>Raise the Bar: </strong>Advocate for product quality, security, availability, and performance. You will define backend standards for style, maintainability, testing, APIs, and operational readiness.</li> <li><strong>Mentor & Lead: </strong>Mentor associate and intermediate engineers, remove technical blockers, and improve team delivery practices through code and design reviews.</li> <li><strong>Operational Excellence: </strong>Diagnose and prevent performance/reliability issues at scale. We value the ability to learn and adapt over mastery of a single language.</li> <li><strong>Architectural Judgment: </strong>Experience designing or evolving modular backend boundaries, bounded contexts, and migration-safe architectures.</li> <li><strong>Influence: </strong>Ability to lead through influence, technical judgment, and clear written communication, effectively bridging the gap between product needs and technical reality.</li> <li><strong>Agentic AI Expertise: </strong>Proven experience building or operating agentic systems in production—moving beyond prompt engineering to architecting loops, tool-use, and error-handling strategies that ensure reliability at scale.</li> </ul> </div> <div><span style="font-size: xx-small;"><span style="color: white;">Remote-Global</span></span></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. title: Senior Staff SRE, Architecture Engineering: Hosted Runners
location: Remote, Canada; Remote, United Kingdom; Remote, United States
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><div class="font-display font-bold text-[19px] mt-5 mb-1.5"><strong>An overview of this role</strong></div> <p class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed mb-2">When a customer pushes a change, they need their CI/CD jobs to start quickly and run reliably, even when demand spikes. You'll help make that happen on GitLab.com by improving how Hosted Runners provision compute, isolate customer workloads, and recover from failures. Your decisions will shape how long customers wait for jobs to start and how efficiently GitLab uses cloud compute.</p> <p class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed mb-2">As a Senior Staff Site Reliability Engineer, you'll set technical direction across teams while continuing to write and operate production software in Go. You'll lead work across the runner control plane, worker provisioning, and job execution. Your primary focus will be GitLab.com, and you'll also provide technical leadership support for GitLab Dedicated Hosted Runners. You'll report to the engineering manager responsible for Hosted Runners.</p> <div class="text-[15px] mb-1 font-semibold"><strong>Some examples of our projects:</strong></div> <ul class="space-y-1.5 ml-4"> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Tuning autoscaling to reduce job wait times during demand spikes</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Evaluating ways to isolate customer workloads</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Improving how runner usage is measured for capacity planning and billing</li> </ul> <div class="font-display font-bold text-[19px] mt-5 mb-1.5"><strong>What You'll Do</strong></div> <ul class="space-y-1.5 ml-4"> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Lead architecture and delivery across teams. Plan migrations with representative workload tests, safe capacity handovers, and rollback paths.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Write, review, and ship Go code across GitLab Runner, autoscaling components, cloud integrations, and operational tooling.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Improve reliability from job pickup through cleanup. Join the Runners Platform on-call rotation, investigate failures across system layers, and verify fixes in production.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Work with Security and Runner engineers to evaluate workload isolation, balancing security and compatibility with performance and cost.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Build observability that connects the customer experience with fleet behavior and guides capacity decisions. Partner with Finance, Product, and the billing platform team on usage metering and cost attribution.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Reduce recurring operational work through automation, tooling, and runbooks that engineers can use independently.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Mentor experienced engineers through design, implementation, and operations. Clarify ownership across teams and help engineers validate AI-assisted changes before they reach production.</li> </ul> <div class="font-display font-bold text-[19px] mt-5 mb-1.5"><strong>What You'll Bring</strong></div> <ul class="space-y-1.5 ml-4"> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Recent hands-on experience building and operating production systems software such as controllers, agents, or schedulers. You've personally shipped code that handles challenges such as concurrency, retries, or resource cleanup.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Strong programming skills in Go or another systems language, with the ability to become productive in Go.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Deep Linux and networking knowledge. You can trace production failures across system layers and use measurements to validate fixes.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Experience operating Kubernetes in production, including diagnosing scheduling and resource issues and managing rollouts and recovery.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Experience building or operating autoscaled or dynamically scheduled compute, such as VM fleets, serverless platforms, or batch systems. You bring experience with public cloud and infrastructure automation or comparable fleet operations.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">A working understanding of the CI job lifecycle and the implications of running customer-controlled code. You can bring that knowledge from outside a CI/CD team.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">A record of leading technical initiatives across teams and personally contributing to implementation through production. title: GTM Pricing & Packaging Lead, Commercial Operations
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: You’ll drive pricing and packaging for our Sales Assist business. As Sales Assist becomes a larger part of Notion’s growth, we need a deliberate approach to pricing through increasingly complex customer journeys. As Notion takes a strong product and brand further up market, you’ll shape how we connect customer value to pricing for B2B and Enterprise customers. Your days may move from a Product discussion to a CRO presentation to a systems-focused meeting, turning GTM insight into investments EPD can act on. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Establish a coherent pricing and packaging perspective for Sales Assist that connects Self Serve pricing, customer value, and the needs of B2B and Enterprise customers. - By your 90th day: - Articulate the Sales Assist pricing-and-packaging narrative and the decisions it should guide. - Deliver a preliminary 18-month pricing and packaging roadmap, grounded in expected business impact and clear prioritization. - Use AI to monitor market trends, validate proposals, and surface business shifts that could change pricing and packaging decisions. - By the end of your first year: - Lead the GTM workstream for at least one pricing or packaging initiative, from recommendation through launch and impact assessment. - Establish a repeatable market-calibration and ROI feedback loop between GTM and EPD, raising the standard for how future investments are evaluated. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - Track record of leading successful launches, starting with initial ideation, operationalization, and post launch analysis that allows us to tie bets with business outcomes. - Exceptional communication, executive presence, and commercial judgment—the role requires influencing Sales, Product, EPD, and senior leadership through complex decisions. - Ability to develop pricing recommendations using quantitative analysis, customer and seller research, market signals, and pricing experiments. - Curiosity and practical AI fluency: you use AI as a collaborator to analyze signals, test assumptions, validate proposals, and make the team’s work easier to build on. - Experience with B2B SaaS & AI Product Pricing, including Enterprise Offerings. - 12+ years experience with Pricing & Packaging. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $230,000 - $280,000 per year. to improve the product user experience.</li> <li>Experience designing and using AI workflows, including evaluating and refining AI-generated output and guiding quality checks for others.</li> <li>Proficiency working in a docs-as-code environment, using the same workflows and tooling as engineering, operations, and product teams.</li> <li>Fluency using the Linux shell and command-line Git, In this quota-carrying role within the Renewals team, you'll work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, and Product to forecast outcomes, reduce churn, and uncover expansion opportunities. In your first year, you'll be focused on building strong relationships with key stakeholders in your accounts, consistently delivering on-time renewals, and contributing to scalable renewal processes that support GitLab's long-term growth.</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Own the end-to-end renewal lifecycle for an assigned portfolio of customer contracts, from early engagement through signed agreement.</li> <li value="2">Develop and execute account-level renewal strategies that protect recurring revenue and reduce customer churn.</li> <li value="3">Prepare renewal proposals, pricing quotes, and contract documentation in line with customer needs and internal guidelines.</li> <li value="4">Lead commercial and contractual negotiations with customer stakeholders, managing pricing discussions, terms, and timelines.</li> <li value="5">Identify and qualify opportunities to expand footprint through upsell and cross-sell in partnership with Sales and Customer Success.</li> <li value="6">Monitor customer health, usage, and satisfaction signals to surface at-risk renewals early and drive mitigation plans.</li> <li value="7">Maintain accurate renewal pipeline, forecasts, and activity tracking in CRM and related systems to enable clear reporting and planning.</li> <li value="8">Collaborate with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, and Product teams to remove obstacles, align on strategy, and ensure timely, smooth renewals.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Fluency in Portuguese and Spanish</li> <li value="1">Experience owning an end-to-end renewal motion for subscription or SaaS contracts, including forecasting, negotiation, and closing.</li> <li value="2">Background in B2B subscription-based businesses with a track record of meeting or exceeding renewal and retention goals.</li> <li value="3">Skill in managing a portfolio of renewal accounts at scale while prioritizing high-impact opportunities and risks.</li> <li value="4">Proficiency working with CRM platforms such as Salesforce or HubSpot, along with strong Excel or Google Sheets skills for analysis and reporting.</li> <li value="5">Ability to build productive relationships with customer stakeholders, navigate complex procurement processes, and lead commercial discussions.</li> <li value="6">Experience partnering with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and Legal to structure renewals, address adoption gaps, and manage contract terms.</li> <li value="7">Strength in identifying renewal risks early, using customer health and usage data, and developing practical mitigation plans.</li> <li value="8">Openness to learning GitLab's platform and processes, with transferable skills welcomed from renewals, account management, sales, or customer success roles.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The Renewals team focuses on protecting and growing GitLab's recurring revenue by managing the full contract lifecycle for our subscription customers. As a Renewal Manager, you'll be part of a quota-carrying team that works closely with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and Legal to ensure timely, accurate renewals and strong customer retention across regions in an all-remote, asynchronous environment. The team is responsible for forecasting renewal outcomes, identifying and addressing churn risk, and uncovering opportunities to expand GitLab adoption, while continuously improving processes and best practices that support predictable, sustainable growth.</p> <h2><strong>How GitLab will support you</strong></h2> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/" target="_blank">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/paid-time-off/" target="_blank">Flexible Paid Time Off</a> </li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/erg-guide/#:~:text=Definition%20of%20the%20TMRG%20%2D%20Team%20Member%20Resource%20Groups,-TMRGs%20are%20voluntary&text=The%20purpose%20for%20this%20type,developing%20the%20sense%20of%20belonging." target="_blank">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/" target="_blank">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/" target="_blank">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave" target="_blank">Parental leave</a> </li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/finance/expenses/#equipment" target="_blank">Home office</a> support</li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. title: Candidate Experience Specialist, Team Lead (AMER)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As the Candidate Experience Team Lead for [Region], you'll own how candidates experience GitLab across your region by raising the capability of the specialists around you. You'll set the quality bar, balance workloads, onboard and develop specialists, and serve as the first escalation point when a process breaks down or a candidate situation needs judgment. You'll stay hands-on with interview coordination, background checks, and offers, while spending most of your time making the regional function run well. You'll use candidate experience data to surface patterns and risks to the Director, Talent Acquisition and Enablement, and partner with leads in other regions to maintain one global process. At GitLab, our mission is simple: to enable everyone to contribute to and co-create the software that powers our world.</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Lead Candidate Experience Specialists in [Region], setting and modeling standards for interview coordination, candidate communication, contract and offer accuracy, and data hygiene in the applicant tracking system.</li> <li value="2">Balance coordination work across the regional team, monitor capacity against hiring volume, and flag resourcing gaps to the Director, Talent Acquisition and Enablement before they affect candidates.</li> <li value="3">Resolve escalated scheduling conflicts, candidate issues, and process gaps, bringing clear recommendations to leadership when further support is needed.</li> <li value="4">Own onboarding, ramp, and ongoing development for new specialists through documentation, shadowing, and direct feedback on work quality.</li> <li value="5">Coordinate interviews, prepare offers and employment contracts, manage background and reference checks, and partner with People Operations on the handoff to onboarding.</li> <li value="6">Build and maintain reporting on candidate satisfaction, specialist response times, scheduling turnaround, and data accuracy to identify patterns, bottlenecks, and risks.</li> <li value="7">Partner with leads in other regions to maintain one global coordination process, contribute regional evidence to process and tooling improvements, implement agreed changes, and keep documentation accurate in the applicant tracking system and GitLab repositories.</li> <li value="8">Collaborate with recruiters, hiring managers, Talent Acquisition leadership, Information Technology, and People Operations across time zones to keep hiring moving, modeling GitLab's values, culture, and all-remote approach in every interaction.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Substantial experience in candidate experience or recruiting coordination, covering interview scheduling, offer and contract preparation, background checks, and onboarding handoffs, including serving as a senior or go-to team member.</li> <li value="2">Ability to lead and develop team members without formal authority through mentoring, onboarding, direct feedback, and influence.</li> <li value="3">Attention to detail in scheduling, contracts, and candidate data, with a record of professionalism, responsiveness, sound judgment under pressure, and maintaining confidentiality.</li> <li value="4">Experience anticipating risks, resolving scheduling and process problems early, prioritizing competing demands, and setting clear expectations about timelines, next steps, and trade-offs.</li> <li value="5">Experience building and maintaining candidate experience or scheduling reports, using data to identify bottlenecks and make a case for change.</li> <li value="6">Experience working across regions or functions to standardize processes, with the judgment to distinguish genuine regional requirements from inconsistent practices.</li> <li value="7">Clear written and verbal communication with candidates and stakeholders at all levels, including executives, and the ability to build collaborative relationships across functions and time zones.</li> <li value="8">Proficiency with an applicant tracking system or interview tool for scheduling, tracking, and stage management, plus Google Workspace and scheduling tools, and a willingness to learn additional tools. Greenhouse and ModernLoop experience is beneficial but not required.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>Our Candidate Experience team supports candidates through interview coordination, offers and contracts, background and reference checks, and the transition to onboarding. As regional leads and specialists, we partner with recruiters, hiring managers, Talent Acquisition leadership, Information Technology, and People Operations to deliver a consistent global candidate experience. We work across time zones, using transparent documentation in the applicant tracking system and GitLab repositories to collaborate asynchronously. Our regional leads work together to resolve process differences and bring regional evidence into global improvements.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only.
